epg.programme_title_en: Deep In The Realm Of Conscience #29 [Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王蓁遇見三恕，三恕藉紫蘭湯一事相勸王蓁。王蓁對純熙關懷備至，更表示會協助照顧純熙孩兒。可謙分別與碧雲、相思談及往事，二人感窩心。芳媚心煩氣躁，向王蓁及太平出氣。未幾，芳媚突然薨逝，隆基建議剖屍檢驗查探內情，王蓁、太平均強烈反對……三恕、何離意外發現藥庫的千山靈芝失竊，相思偶然得知竊賊竟是可謙，可謙向相思道出原委，相思聞言動容。龍武軍在碧雲房間搜獲千山靈芝，審問期間，相思指證乃碧雲盜竊，眾人詫異……

epg.programme_title_en: Deep In The Realm Of Conscience #30 [Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧雲不忿被相思出賣，反指相思與可謙淫亂後宮。碧雲、相思與可謙一同被收押。碧雲、相思在牢房繼續互相指斥，可謙忍無可忍怒罵二人。龍武軍終查出真相，可謙得到應有下場。可謙助手茗風求王蓁拯救恩師，王蓁答應。王蓁為隆基打點純熙孩兒之事，隆基心中感慨。李旦自芳媚離世後，變得暴躁易怒，雨嫣處處體諒。隆基和雨嫣聊起舊事，隆基敬重雨嫣慈祥可親，得知雨嫣手患紅疹，更表現關心。隆基繼續調查芳媚的死因，竟有意外發現……

epg.programme_title_en: Deep In The Realm Of Conscience #31 [Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太平、隆基分別查出芳媚之死跟雨嫣有關，雨嫣終將事情始末和盤托出。李旦親自審問雨嫣，雨嫣的回應令李旦痛心。李旦決定待純熙誕下孩子後，便交出所有皇權。隆基滿懷期盼，積極為孩兒取名。王蓁眼見隆基對純熙日趨體貼，感到茫然若失。宮中流傳摸過「金鵲來朝樹」上的喜鵲蛋，就會一索得男，純熙得知後躍躍欲試。元玥勸阻不果，唯有為純熙代勞。元玥爬梯時發生意外，傷及純熙！隆基驚聞噩耗，震撼痛心，元玥帶同寶劍向隆基請罪……
傲擊殺生，卻嫁禍於血影教，瓏指證傲才是兇手，傲暈倒。問病情突然急轉直下，磊冒生命危險終治好問之傷。傲心灰意冷，更將掌門之位傳給瓏，要瓏聯絡問，令血影教與其他八大派簽定和約。瓏發現風將要和靈成親。
(大結局)原來瓏的和約協議，只是傲與浩的陰謀。武林大會如期進行，浩發難重傷了問。傲追殺眾人，問更被擊殺，而風更被重傷。風與磊發現天一谷收藏失傳武功秘笈，更發現傲使出「天玄北斗陣」第七招後就會自爆而亡。

玉華安排平安跟范家少爺三東相親，平安向孝義傾訴。孝義見三東相貌人品俱佳，頓表放心，平安聞言感失落。相親之日，三東對平安印象甚佳；世昌突然出現，令平安下定決心要向三東說明一切。南京難民日增，世昌決借助孝義幫忙救助難民。孝義與振聲等發放消息，令難民到米倉奪米，孝義因開米倉而被收監。平安向玉華借錢救孝義，玉華拒絕。平安向月鳳借錢作疏通獄吏之用。世昌估計松田毅刻意安排孝義轉監獄來試探自己，想辦法營救孝義。
平安奮身擋車，振聲與難民及記者等製造輿論壓力，令孝義得以獲釋。依萍查得松田毅乃日軍少佐，官階甚高，打算對付松田毅以打擊日軍。松田毅約世昌見面，質問白米轉運到寧波之事，世昌正解釋並表示願作賠償之際，政府軍突然掩至，松田毅、世昌慌忙逃命。世昌則被捕入獄，田毅命下屬監視世昌。月鳳兄嫂向她要錢逃離南京，月鳳感到家人只當自己是搖錢樹，在夫家又受到迫害，悲從中來，告知孝義不會再探望小貓，拿了小貓的鈴鐺留念。

epg.programme_title_en: Deep In The Realm Of Conscience #29 [Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王蓁遇見三恕，三恕藉紫蘭湯一事相勸王蓁。王蓁對純熙關懷備至，更表示會協助照顧純熙孩兒。可謙分別與碧雲、相思談及往事，二人感窩心。芳媚心煩氣躁，向王蓁及太平出氣。未幾，芳媚突然薨逝，隆基建議剖屍檢驗查探內情，王蓁、太平均強烈反對……三恕、何離意外發現藥庫的千山靈芝失竊，相思偶然得知竊賊竟是可謙，可謙向相思道出原委，相思聞言動容。龍武軍在碧雲房間搜獲千山靈芝，審問期間，相思指證乃碧雲盜竊，眾人詫異……

epg.programme_title_en: Deep In The Realm Of Conscience #30 [Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧雲不忿被相思出賣，反指相思與可謙淫亂後宮。碧雲、相思與可謙一同被收押。碧雲、相思在牢房繼續互相指斥，可謙忍無可忍怒罵二人。龍武軍終查出真相，可謙得到應有下場。可謙助手茗風求王蓁拯救恩師，王蓁答應。王蓁為隆基打點純熙孩兒之事，隆基心中感慨。李旦自芳媚離世後，變得暴躁易怒，雨嫣處處體諒。隆基和雨嫣聊起舊事，隆基敬重雨嫣慈祥可親，得知雨嫣手患紅疹，更表現關心。隆基繼續調查芳媚的死因，竟有意外發現……

游被判秋後處決。娘知寧王有免死金牌，決參選花魁，以接近寧王。眾以為娘貪圖富貴，娘飽受委屈。夢與蜂王雌雄合體，夢見娘，欲迫娘就範。寧王抽得娘為花魁，夢扮娘騙取清虛石。幸寧王早有防備，以斬妖劍殺蜂王，娘耗盡功力，夢與蜂王終被剷除，娘以免死金牌救游。游耿耿於懷，未能原諒娘，後方知寧王與娘結為義兄妹。娘心死跳崖，游亦跳下，此時，石飛墮化為仙山，娘、游成仙，寧王欣羨。
性治療師林靜兒與社工男友莫大雄，為身邊的家人及好友解決男女間的糾紛，並為他們的性生活作出指引。偏偏二人婚後也問題多多，導致壓力爆煲，陷入不育危機。出盡心思幫助別人的這對夫婦，能醫而不自醫？

督察胡天揚登上志峰家門，表示其大兒子偉舜牽涉一宗殺人案，志峰擔心之餘，亦稱兒子近日所去無蹤。童日受託照顧志峰的小兒子，二人同樣高智商，志趣相投。志峰請求泰然幫忙尋找偉舜下落，童日即從偉舜的社交網站帳號入手，找到線索。泰然分析偉舜性格，認為他為人內向，喜歡流連網絡世界逃避現實。童日亦從電腦的備份紀錄中推測，偉舜與女死者是網絡情侶……
泰然訪問昔日校園兇案的受害者家人，排除健強因感情問題而行兇，但這卻令泰然更一籌莫展。巧敏因捲入三角關係被潑紅油，於是走上泰然家梳洗，並趁機示好，但她隨後發現泰然對秀怡仍念念不忘，怒怨一觸即發。美欣私下約見泰然，討論取回偉聰撫養權一事，此時志峰衝入辦公室與美欣對質，還得悉偉聰原來並非親生。偉舜偷偷與志峰見面，並將兇案的真相娓娓道來……

殷賞欲離開香港之際，麗薇突然到訪；殷賞坦白相告汝大之事，麗薇亦說出心底話，更後悔從沒對閆器及汝大表達關愛。麗薇把一部mp3機交給殷賞，表示若汝大甦醒，便讓他聽當中內容。家昇找來白金龍暫代主編，他未正式接手便大顯氣焰，眾同事暗感不滿。寶拉把完成了的封面故事初稿交給家昇過目，他大表驚訝。麗薇到警署自首，一力承擔責任。七俠到警署探望舊同事，順道打探金波一案；Linda道出麗薇所說的版本，七俠才得悉閆器苦心。家昇探望汝大，更用朋友身分和汝大說話，這時汝大的手微微郁動……

殷賞剛完成採訪欲離開警校之際，竟看見家昇；而他只向殷賞說了一句「對不起」。殷賞推斷家昇應是臥底身分，礙於保密守則無法回答殷賞。寶拉辭職收拾後，主動向賞坦白一切。家昇從樂兒口中得悉殷賞正跟進黑幫老大「氹仔文」的新聞，殷賞決定扮文已死去的太太套料。家昇要國仁勸服殷賞取消訪問，可惜失敗。殷賞為向家昇報復，執意繼續跟進訪問；家昇忍不住到夜總會門外等候，卻見她與文一同步出。家昇硬着頭皮欲拉走殷賞，殷賞卻拒絕離開；文見狀反替殷賞解困。家昇再收到殷賞陪文出席社團飯局消息…….

汝大甦醒後，金波集團回復正常，而雜誌社自家昇辭職後，亦逐漸適應。殷賞不忿家昇不辭而別，再上稻草人網誌看家昇有否留下新帖文；寶拉希望在新一期探討物流業，殷賞安排她採訪金波物流部的堯哥；但原來寶拉另有目的……寶拉成功為詩卿找出證據，臥底任務亦正式告終。寶拉雖為脫離臥底生涯高興，但又發現自己原來也喜歡記者工作；她最終決定向詩卿辭去警察一職。寶拉離開警署時，無意中看見家昇的蹤影；寶拉將手上欲採訪「警察教官」專題交回殷賞處理，而殷賞為替寶拉完成心願，答應她親自跟進這個專訪。

殷賞剛完成採訪欲離開警校之際，竟看見家昇；而他只向殷賞說了一句「對不起」。殷賞推斷家昇應是臥底身分，礙於保密守則無法回答殷賞。寶拉辭職收拾後，主動向賞坦白一切。家昇從樂兒口中得悉殷賞正跟進黑幫老大「氹仔文」的新聞，殷賞決定扮文已死去的太太套料。家昇要國仁勸服殷賞取消訪問，可惜失敗。殷賞為向家昇報復，執意繼續跟進訪問；家昇忍不住到夜總會門外等候，卻見她與文一同步出。家昇硬着頭皮欲拉走殷賞，殷賞卻拒絕離開；文見狀反替殷賞解困。家昇再收到殷賞陪文出席社團飯局消息…….
游被判秋後處決。娘知寧王有免死金牌，決參選花魁，以接近寧王。眾以為娘貪圖富貴，娘飽受委屈。夢與蜂王雌雄合體，夢見娘，欲迫娘就範。寧王抽得娘為花魁，夢扮娘騙取清虛石。幸寧王早有防備，以斬妖劍殺蜂王，娘耗盡功力，夢與蜂王終被剷除，娘以免死金牌救游。游耿耿於懷，未能原諒娘，後方知寧王與娘結為義兄妹。娘心死跳崖，游亦跳下，此時，石飛墮化為仙山，娘、游成仙，寧王欣羨。

運動員們都努力練習，力爭有好表現。近期，香港的游泳代表隊與馬術代表隊，在中國內地的比賽上取得佳績，為港增光。伴隨輕快的音樂，李睿晴、陳逸晞、張滋楹、黃天瑜帶來既合拍又可愛的舞蹈。她們還將拱橋、一字馬、前手翻等高難度動作融入表演中，獲主持們熱烈鼓掌。除了這次的「My Little Show」演出，她們還期望將來可「跳」出香港！另外，「小手指工作室」教大家把廢紙盒再用，製成有趣的「紙盒蒸汽火車」。
前田生日將至，小丸子、小玉和山田獲邀參加其生日會，他們決定投其所好，製作和星空有關的禮物。小丸子從濱治口中得知混合食物可以得出不同的味道，她於是回家嘗試，更把爺爺和佐佐木也拖下水。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
一幅幅的圖畫，為甚麼串連在一起會���成動畫？要了解當中底蘊，首先要了解視覺停留。其實視覺停留是錯覺的一種，當物件在眼前移走，但物件的影像在視網膜上並沒有即時消失，而會短暫時間停留。所以如果在影像消失前，再看到另一個影像，眼睛就會將前後影像的畫面組合。根據這個現象，只需要將一系列連貫動作的畫面快速地播放，就可以做出動畫的效果。那麼，連貫性畫面要以甚麼速度移動，才能產生動畫的效果？
是日母親節，多啦A夢見大雄只是摘了蒲公英送給媽媽，便用「體貼長槍」讓媽媽倍感受到關懷。多啦A夢患感冒，多啦美留了藥水給他，誰知有人誤把「聲音凝固劑」當作藥水吞服，結果弄得一團亂。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
運動員們都努力練習，力爭有好表現。近期，香港的游泳代表隊與馬術代表隊，在中國內地的比賽上取得佳績，為港增光。伴隨輕快的音樂，李睿晴、陳逸晞、張滋楹、黃天瑜帶來既合拍又可愛的舞蹈。她們還將拱橋、一字馬、前手翻等高難度動作融入表演中，獲主持們熱烈鼓掌。除了這次的「My Little Show」演出，她們還期望將來可「跳」出香港！另外，「小手指工作室」教大家把廢紙盒再用，製成有趣的「紙盒蒸汽火車」。
前田生日將至，小丸子、小玉和山田獲邀參加其生日會，他們決定投其所好，製作和星空有關的禮物。小丸子從濱治口中得知混合食物可以得出不同的味道，她於是回家嘗試，更把爺爺和佐佐木也拖下水。

一幅幅的圖畫，為甚麼串連在一起會變成動畫？要了解當中底蘊，首先要了解視覺停留。其實視覺停留是錯覺的一種，當物件在眼前移走，但物件的影像在視網膜上並沒有即時消失，而會短暫時間停留。所以如果在影像消失前，再看到另一個影像，眼睛就會將前後影像的畫面組合。根據這個現象，只需要將一系列連貫動作的畫面快速地播放，就可以做出動畫的效果。那麼，連貫性畫面要以甚麼速度移動，才能產生動畫的效果？
是日母親節，多啦A夢見大雄只是摘了蒲公英送給媽媽，便用「體貼長槍」讓媽媽倍感受到關懷。多啦A夢患感冒，多啦美留了藥水給他，誰知有人誤把「聲音凝固劑」當作藥水吞服，結果弄得一團亂。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
運動員們都努力練習，力爭有好表現。近期，香港的游泳代表隊與馬術代表隊，在中國內地的比賽上取得佳績，為港增光。伴隨輕快的音樂，李睿晴、陳逸晞、張滋楹、黃天瑜帶來既合拍又可愛的舞蹈。她們還將拱橋、一字馬、前手翻等高難度動作融入表演中，獲主持們熱烈鼓掌。除了這次的「My Little Show」演出，她們還期望將來可「跳」出香港！另外，「小手指工作室」教大家把廢紙盒再用，製成有趣的「紙盒蒸汽火車」。

如何能令摩天輪模型轉動？其實摩天輪模型除了輪身和支架之外，還有一個摩打，而摩打上面掛了一條橡筋，連接著輪身。當我們按動開關掣，電線就會連成一條閉合電路，電流由電池流向摩打，摩打就會帶動橡筋，拉動摩天輪旋轉。而通過改變電線的位置和橡筋的數量，就可以輕鬆改變摩天輪轉動的方向和速度。懂得令摩天輪轉動的方法後，老師還教大家用簡單的材料，製造一個不用電池亦能轉動的環保摩天輪。

講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
零食廠內，曲奇、薯片小兵團在「舉旗仔」遊戲，各有一人犯錯被淘汰，剩下兩名成員各自肩負為團隊爭勝的重任，結果怎樣？曲奇兵團先開始「拼砌軟墊渡河」，有隊員將手握成拳頭，以搥打的方法來砌軟墊，速度甚快，最終只花了兩分多鐘就完成任務。
濱治在學校游泳時不小心丟失內褲，要全班替他搜索，偏偏內褲殘舊不堪，令他情願內褲就此消失。隔鄰班的小池將會上電視參加問答遊戲節目，小丸子託他問司儀拿簽名，更約了小玉父女到家中看直播。

我們身處的地球有地心吸力，在地心吸力的作用之下，所有物體都有一個可以保持平衡的點，叫作「重心」。根據資料顯示，物體的重心若在物體的底面積範圍之內，就可以保持平衡。如何令一張普通的畫紙站穩？畫紙與桌面接觸的面積太小，一定站不穩，但是將其對摺後，接觸桌面的底面積較之前大，畫紙的重心不易偏離底面積範圍，就可在桌面上站穩。鉛筆居然能以筆尖站立起來，同樣與重心有關，究竟是甚麼方法？

本集請來羅燕慈教練以及兩位學員繼續為大家講解及示範乒乓球發球的正確姿勢和打法。在「開心活力趣乒乓」第一擊中，大家可以學習乒乓球的發球技術，發球分為三種－上旋球、下旋球、以及側旋球。在第二擊中，羅教練教大家接球技術中的其中兩款－反手搓球、加轉弧圈球。而在第三擊，教練與學員會示範乒乓雙打時的步法及位置。另外，在「乒乓小百科」，羅教練會講解一些關於乒乓球的知識，亦會介紹香港乒乓球代表隊的世界排名。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
阿智彥為了得到喵姆的力量，打算讓她出道成為星光魔法之星。休伊知道後深感擔憂，決定用蒼狼的力量做籌碼，向阿智彥提議由自己代替喵姆。臨登台之際，橙真突然來到，並要和休伊一起表演星光魔法。

epg.programme_title_tc: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖! #6 [粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 展鵬與文柔的獨女「小豬比」渴望照顧弟妹，這次遇上素人小妹妹Sophia，盡顯大姐姐特質。要女兒坐定用餐，向來不設界線的素人爸爸直言不可能！小豬比盡力引導Sophia乖乖坐低，還遞士多啤梨給大家吃。甫聽到要跟爸爸暫時分離，小豬比突然爆喊，展鵬緊張之外，也欣然在女兒心中有地位？展鵬遙距指導小豬比執行家姐任務，餵妹妹飲奶、幫忙穿外套和鞋子，場面動人！父女齊齊藉心意卡向媽媽表愛意，「愛妻號」展鵬繼續放閃！

本集請來羅燕慈教練以及兩位學員繼續為大家講解及示範乒乓球發球的正確姿勢和打法。在「開心活力趣乒乓」第一擊中，大家可以學習乒乓球的發球技術，發球分為三種－上旋球、下旋球、以及側旋球。在第二擊中，羅教練教大家接球技術中的其中兩款－反手搓球、加轉弧圈球。而在第三擊，教練與學員會示範乒乓雙打時的步法及位置。另外，在「乒乓小百科」，羅教練會講解一些關於乒乓球的知識，亦會介紹香港乒乓球代表隊的世界排名。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
阿智彥為了得到喵姆的力量，打算讓她出道成為星光魔法之星。休伊知道後深感擔憂，決定用蒼狼的力量做籌碼，向阿智彥提議由自己代替喵姆。臨登台之際，橙真突然來到，並要和休伊一起表演星光魔法。

epg.programme_title_tc: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖! #6 [粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 展鵬與文柔的獨女「小豬比」渴望照顧弟妹，這次遇上素人小妹妹Sophia，盡顯大姐姐特質。要女兒坐定用餐，向來不設界線的素人爸爸直言不可能！小豬比盡力引導Sophia乖乖坐低，還遞士多啤梨給大家吃。甫聽到要跟爸爸暫時分離，小豬比突然爆喊，展鵬緊張之外，也欣然在女兒心中有地位？展鵬遙距指導小豬比執行家姐任務，餵妹妹飲奶、幫忙穿外套和鞋子，場面動人！父女齊齊藉心意卡向媽媽表愛意，「愛妻號」展鵬繼續放閃！

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要幼子「搏啜」何少弘抵抗糖果誘惑並留在身邊，爸爸何兆鴻率先發功；媽媽吳若希見勢色不對，即出絕招！緊接快問快答，兆鴻竟對兒子心愛顏色、所穿鞋碼統統不了解？首項湊仔任務，兆鴻要教兒子學懂十個中文生字，但搏啜很快就坐唔定，諾懿緊急出手示範以五感教育刺激學習。其實欠專注之人不止搏啜，兆鴻教學時經常分心搵鏡頭，更漸變玩樂時間……一直暗中監察的若希，為何頻稱丈夫好虛偽？一家人視像連線檢視學習成果，結果有驚喜！
本集請來羅燕慈教練以及兩位學員繼續為大家講解及示範乒乓球發球的正確姿勢和打法。在「開心活力趣乒乓」第一擊中，大家可以學習乒乓球的發球技術，發球分為三種－上旋球、下旋球、以及側旋球。在第二擊中，羅教練教大家接球技術中的其中兩款－反手搓球、加轉弧圈球。而在第三擊，教練與學員會示範乒乓雙打時的步法及位置。另外，在「乒乓小百科」，羅教練會講解一些關於乒乓球的知識，亦會介紹香港乒乓球代表隊的世界排名。

未來世界，灰心星球的大大怪和小小怪攜帶具有強大力量的五顆機械石侵略星星球，其中四顆和宇宙中流浪的四輛廢舊機車意外結合，在宅博士的幫助下變成了開心超人、甜心超人、粗心超人和花心超人。
未來世界，灰心星球的大大怪和小小怪攜帶具有強大力量的五顆機械石侵略星星球，其中四顆和宇宙中流浪的四輛廢舊機車意外結合，在宅博士的幫助下變成了開心超人、甜心超人、粗心超人和花心超人。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
小祭提議嘗試雙人組合，休伊於是辦一場「憑感覺雙人配對大賽」，讓大家向心儀的對象推薦自己。甜音與希娜組隊，小祭與阿烏魯被喵姆拉走，剩下的檸檬與米露琪都表示自己一個更樂得輕鬆。

epg.programme_title_en: Amazing Animals - New Records of Animals #8 [Can/Man]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！
種植是一門學問，每個品種都有牠的特性，種植前務必做足功課。這集「大世界 小知識」發問四道有關萬壽菊的問題，各位小朋友又認識幾多？有小朋友稱在學校見到萬壽菊，認為牠和教師有關，故選定花語是「善良的教育」，但答案似乎有異。澆水是種植時的重要一環，為萬壽菊澆水前，應做甚麼檢查？而花盆盆底需要有排水孔、加上膠袋或擺放一些樹枝？打理萬壽菊雖不困難，但記得每兩至三星期要施肥，為植物提供充足養分。
大野的足球隊練習途中小休，正當他們準備吃飯糰，便吸引了餓肚子的小杉到場要飯。比賽在即，足球隊又剛好缺人，小杉便在健太等人邀請下，成為足球隊的外援球員。小杉憑著肥大的身形，擔任很稱職的守門員。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
從古到今，科學於我們的生活中無處不在。古人打仗時候使用的投石車，就是利用了槓桿原理，發射器和基座接觸的地方就是支點，而在發射器一端施加向下的壓力後，支點一邊往下，就會帶動支點另一邊向上用力，從而將放在發射板尾的石塊發射出去，這樣就能將石塊拋得又高又遠。古代亦有土人用吹矢作為武器，它又與甚麼原理有關呢？甚麼因素會影響矢的飛行距離？而木筏為甚麼能浮起？木筏又能夠承載多少重量？
巨人隊慘敗給暴龍隊，多啦A夢拿出「前路指示器」，讓大雄按指示走尋找解決方法。爸爸要去攀登尖岳，媽媽表示擔心並反對，多啦A夢拿出法寶「護身符」，見大家對功效存疑，便先以大雄作試驗。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

大野的足球隊練習途中小休，正當他們準備吃飯糰，便吸引了餓肚子的小杉到場要飯。比賽在即，足球隊又剛好缺人，小杉便在健太等人邀請下，成為足球隊的外援球員。小杉憑著肥大的身形，擔任很稱職的守門員。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 施桂芬偶遇程持忠，得悉忠父文耀乃惡名昭彰之狀師，憤而離去。芬撞破嫂楊杏薇的姦情，遭誣陷殺兄，忠求耀代芬寫狀紙申冤。官員受薇所賄，耀父子申冤無門，幸得巡按明察為芬昭雪沉冤，薇與姦夫伏法，忠、芬喜成佳偶。
徐淑娟為家貧學生林小明與校長爭執，憤而辭職到孤兒院任院長，而明終被趕出校，淪為街童。娟與表哥李義將街童接到孤兒院，明為救院友致雙腳殘廢。娟答應隨義出國留學，義在歡送會上被孤兒們的歌聲感動，決與娟留下。
阿妙被偷銀両而欠飯錢，幸得周添幫忙，並收留在周家打工。添女兒秀嫻與徐季良有婚約，良要與嫻相見才成婚，但嫻因病變成啞巴，妙遂獻計代嫻說話。結婚日，良得悉被騙，大怒。嫻病倒竟因此恢復說話能力，並與良和好。
李霜萍遭退婚後，與表弟張雲生相戀，卻遭張母反對，時萍已懷有生的骨肉，仍無奈嫁予莫仲良，不久良意外身亡。生重遇舊同學莫錦霞，並暫住莫家，得以與萍相見。霞雖暗戀生，但她得悉生與萍的關係後，決助二人續前緣。
方繼祖父親被奸臣殺害，忠僕吳璧帶同祖夫婦投靠其弟吳璞。徐勝挑撥是非，璞為自保誤殺祖夫婦，二人遺下龍鳳胎。龍竹與靈潔學成下山為父母報仇，璧之女玉燕四出尋武林好友調解，惜竹兄妹誓不罷休，璧終自盡了斷恩怨。

東宮娘娘林瓊玉身懷齊昭王的骨肉，遭西宮陷害而流亡，她途中產子後與子失散。民女萬里紅與昭王有枕藉之親後身懷帝裔，惜孩兒夭折，她後來拾得太子，認他作親兒，獲昭王封為東宮。多年後，玉與子重遇，誓要與紅爭子。
陳火被四眼張陷害入獄，出獄前夕，火妻病逝，臨終前託杜仲文照顧子女阿蘭及洪仔。火出獄後不敢與子女相認，但對他們照顧有加。洪患急症，蘭為醫藥費及還債賣身，火為救子女，助張行竊，後雖與子女相認，卻難逃法網。
錢麗英繼承千萬遺產後，吩咐秘書錢嬌假扮自己代為應酬。汪財逼兒子汪忠追求英，希望得到資金周轉。忠與真正的英邂逅，一見鍾情，卻被財棒打鴛鴦。忠與嬌結婚日，驚見英任伴娘，禮成後，忠與財方知一切，財悔不當初。
陳玲、周大海、李明、亞全以行騙為生，玲對此生涯感厭倦，於是海提出要她誘騙慈善家謝雲，成功後便可收手。玲以美色吸引雲，讓雲對她展開熱烈追求，後雲更向玲求婚。玲為了離隊，遂讓全及明假扮其父母，騙取雲金錢。
黃飛鴻因徒弟凌雲階闖禍，兩人改名換姓逃亡至廣西，並分別認識了莫文鳳、莫文兒兩姊妹。一次，階打傷鳳之兄長，鳳父莫天豹大怒，相約階比武，階落敗受傷。後鳳、兒遭豹逼婚，鴻、階出手相助，將惡人懲治。

陳火被四眼張陷害入獄，出獄前夕，火妻病逝，臨終前託杜仲文照顧子女阿蘭及洪仔。火出獄後不敢與子女相認，但對他們照顧有加。洪患急症，蘭為醫藥費及還債賣身，火為救子女，助張行竊，後雖與子女相認，卻難逃法網。
陳玲、周大海、李明、亞全以行騙為生，玲對此生涯感厭倦，於是海提出要她誘騙慈善家謝雲，成功後便可收手。玲以美色吸引雲，讓雲對她展開熱烈追求，後雲更向玲求婚。玲為了離隊，遂讓全及明假扮其父母，騙取雲金錢。
東宮娘娘林瓊玉身懷齊昭王的骨肉，遭西宮陷害而流亡，她途中產子後與子失散。民女萬里紅與昭王有枕藉之親後身懷帝裔，惜孩兒夭折，她後來拾得太子，認他作親兒，獲昭王封為東宮。多年後，玉與子重遇，誓要與紅爭子。

洪丞相謀朝奪位，忠臣陸俊以親生女嬰換走龍雲太子，洪被勸冊封女嬰為笑雲公主。多年後，笑雲得知身世，往找與她有婚約的龍雲，但她把龍雲的孿生弟龍華錯認，華更當選駙馬。幸此時龍雲帶兵進宮誅殺逆賊，各人終相認。
吳冠城為兒子蝦仔的將來，離開義學，讓蝦仔入讀名校。蝦仔即將生日，城為蝦仔辦生日會，豈料蝦仔的有錢同學嫌棄其家居環境，紛紛離去，幸好義學的同學來給蝦仔慶生，令蝦仔非常開心。城終於醒悟，讓蝦仔回義學讀書。
周時新誘騙何日興做生意還債。興女何帶子誤墮騙局被禁錮，新妹周南絲暗中發勒索信訛稱子被綁架索贖金還巨債。興放棄投資生意救女，新唯有偷取贖金；幸子得恩人所救。新還債時發現贖金消失，原來絲已將贖金歸還給興。
江山家園被燒，幸得新房東孔媽照顧，並與其女孔靜儀相戀。儀介紹山到侯家工作，侯悅容看上山，苦苦痴纏。管家一直覬覦侯家家財，儀因妒嫉竟與管家合謀害容，幸儀懸崖勒馬。容明白山愛儀，毅然讓愛，山與儀共諧連理。

錦毛鼠白玉堂不忿展昭被封御貓，潛入皇宮盜三寶以留難昭，皇上命昭限期尋回。昭妹秋霜喜歡堂，昭妻與四鼠合計撮合二人，伺機取回三寶，卻遭昭反對，婚事告吹。霜不忍二人為敵欲輕生，幸包公施計令堂娶霜並交出三寶。
汽車經紀呂永康與播音員莊佩華有七名孩子，康的客戶陳經理夫婦仰慕華，聲言若華到訪他們家就會買車，事情卻給七小福搞砸。陳氏夫婦離港旅遊在即，臨行前欲聽華講故事，華因病失聲，幸七小福幕後代講，康終簽妥合約。

epg.programme_title_en: Taking a Wife the Hard Way
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬文亮欲與女友陳麗霞結婚，梁財興提議亮每月向他上繳二百元代亮儲蓄。豈料興用盡亮的「老婆本」，婚宴當天亮無錢支付費用，霞偷取母親的錢救夫，惹惱母親，不准他們洞房。霞與好友設計令興還錢，霞母終讓二人圓房。
莫七以偷竊為生，租住戀人阿英之姊的旅店。英受盡其姐欺凌，仍不忘勸七改過自身，七答允。可是七為幫鄰居阿海籌殮葬費，再犯險被捕入獄。英欲等七刑滿，但其姐將她賣予妓院，英不甘當娼自殺。七回首往昔，無限唏噓。
左鑑白夫婦被指殺害四大派掌門，遭武林人士追殺。鑑白夫婦及長子繼白被殺，女兒文娟跳崖，幼子少白則逃出生天，並獲天劍、絕刀傳授武藝。五年後，娟成為劍主，少白與黃榮等人組成金刀幫，追查當年四大掌門被殺真相。

趙小雲為替母親治病，被逼於舞廳工作。男友張俊文不喜小雲拋頭露面，遂借巨款為她贖身，並與小雲結婚。婚後俊文既要還債，又要照顧小雲的家人，只好作兼職以增加收入。小雲偶然得悉俊文借款之事，卻無力幫忙，可是她因一次感不適，往醫院檢驗，始知得了胃癌，於是遂決定瞞著俊文重操故業，以替俊文還債並改善家人的生活。俊文得悉小雲再作舞女，憤而與她分開。小雲用剩餘時光還清債項，終於離世，俊文事後方知真相，惜已追悔莫及。

南宮正和同情武蕊卿，於燕子箋上賦詩。賈良駒夫婦為霸佔家財，毒殺兄長並嫁禍予卿，妯娌阮珍珠更以燕子箋力證卿與和有私情。卿含冤自盡，和判候斬。卿妹武二蠻施計令駒夫婦自招罪狀，為卿、和雪冤，並與和締結良緣。
醫生范田笙被杜濟仁陷害賣假藥，判監二十年，其妻臨死前託老王收養兒子復群。十年後，逃獄的笙遇上群，決定以無名氏身分供他習醫。群長大後辦醫院，卻誤以為仁是無名氏，聽從仁擺佈，幸笙告知群真相，並與群相認。
吳農望和王天生雖為鄰居，卻因文化差異而不時吵鬧；農子繼望和生女鳳娥同是鬥氣冤家，後發現對方是愛慕的筆友，和好墮愛河。為讓農、生不阻二人交往，娥表哥獻計要望、娥裝瘋，並以生意作餌，終讓兩家由冤家成親家。
（續上集）左少白等人從閑雲大師口中得悉四大派掌門被害真相，於是眾人往少林寺，揭發聖君收買四大派弟子害師奪位，欲當武林霸主之企圖，還混入聖君門，期間白與姊文娟重逢。聖君坦承當年陷害白父母，白終手刃仇人。
交際花郭綺薇與醫生駱家昭情投意合，薇為昭洗盡鉛華，但昭舅父為撮合其女龐麗華與昭，逼薇退出，薇為昭前途忍痛分手。昭以為薇自甘墮落，當眾羞辱她。華得知其父從中作梗拆散二人，遂告知昭真相，昭與薇冰釋、和好。

南宮正和同情武蕊卿，於燕子箋上賦詩。賈良駒夫婦為霸佔家財，毒殺兄長並嫁禍予卿，妯娌阮珍珠更以燕子箋力證卿與和有私情。卿含冤自盡，和判候斬。卿妹武二蠻施計令駒夫婦自招罪狀，為卿、和雪冤，並與和締結良緣。

epg.programme_title_en: Lau Kam Ding and Ko Kwun Bo
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高君保赴壽州救駕，途中遇上稱是他未婚妻的劉金定，定更施計讓保訂下鴛盟。保被困壽州，定往查探，宋帝趙匡胤賞識定，欲納她為妃，禁止男士進入其營房。保犯險探營而差點被斬，幸御妹、皇嫂威逼胤，保與定終成眷屬。
林志雄與王美玲相愛，雄到姑丈的公司任職副經理，而玲父原來是該公司的董事長，玲亦在公司出任會計主任，她誤會雄戲弄她，二人鬥氣。郭添趁機追求玲，玲賭氣與添結婚。結婚日，雄假裝自殺讓玲表白，二人和好成眷屬。
朱潤祥見工被騙金錢，於債主孔家的雲吞麵店工作，卻遭同事沙皮狗針對，幸獲店主女兒孔珍妮賞識。何伯壇於隔鄰開設上海麵店，祥亦被他挖角。狗與老千合謀向孔家騙財，幸祥及時阻止，並提議妮與壇合營麵店，和氣生財。
鐵面道人鑄成紫電劍及神風劍，吳史德為奪劍殺了鐵面，幸其愛徒姚家玉趕至擊退德。德與高戴瑞奪劍失敗，投宿韋漢雄家，二人趁雄上山取劍，殺害雄母。玉與其姊家碧將德、瑞惡行告知雄，三人往報仇，將吳家莊等人剷除。
富家子張永超對馮家婢女阿冰一見鍾情，假扮菜販結識她；超的司機阿德與洗衣女阿蘭相戀；德助蘭兄李明假扮闊少，認識千金小姐馮麗燕。最後超父張康年拆穿各人的騙局，幸年及燕父母放下門戶之見，三對有情人得成眷屬。

epg.programme_title_en: Couple and the Magic Lamp, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇帝駕崩，西宮奪位，駙馬衛國忠請任展鵬與白騰蛟相助。林飛鳳、林飛鶯兩姐妹唆使刺殺忠，幸被鵬等人制止。國舅劉厚瑞追殺太子，鵬借助神燈救走他。厚欲屠殺全城嬰兒，蛟以親兒頂替太子，並與鵬、鳳合計終推翻西宮。
鏢頭呂騰空受託護送錦盒給金鞭大俠韓遜，不料江湖盛傳空護送武林至寶，空與妻西門一娘遭各派截劫，幸終把錦盒送交遜。遜發現內藏兒子頭顱，與空夫婦惡鬥，娘喪命。後遜被殺，其女玉霞誤會空是兇手，將空之子麟毒打。
莊健華被發現死於海灘，其表弟丁子傑懷疑華妻何麗萍串謀駱大標謀財害命。其後傑發現標是真兇，建議萍報警，萍卻決定殺標報仇，惜失敗，幸傑及時相救。標綁架萍子明仔，要萍單獨帶錢給他，傑放心不下，悄悄跟蹤萍……
許君傑為報答丁家珠相助解困，答應她假扮其夫婿，來瞞騙她失散多年的父親丁晚成。可是珠、傑破綻百出，令珠表哥蘇士超起疑，並收買傭人彩姐監視，終揭穿傑之身分。超欲娶珠謀其家產，惜事敗，成遂讓珠、傑弄假成真。
程允中到徐守江家中工作時，以為應徵家庭教師的伍月華是江的千金。後華往中的電器店獲聘為售貨員，中因誤會其身分而對她管接管送。兩人經常出現徐家，惹來江夫婦誤會彼此出軌，幸華向二人及中解釋，中與華共墮愛河。

在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冠軍賽慘遭擊倒後,泰拳女拳手自昏迷中甦醒,卻發現自己被困於一片由塵封恐懼滋生的夢魘之地。在神祕青年的引導下,她以故鄉的呵叻流泰拳迎戰內心的惡念,穿越層層幻象的搏殺,重新尋回自我。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being knocked out in a championship match, a Muay Thai fighter awakens in a surreal dreamscape born of her buried fears. Guided by a mysterious young man, she must battle inner demons through Korat-style Muay Thai. Her fight through illusions becomes a journey of self-discovery, confronting the darkness within to reclaim her true identity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女模特余虹敏入住了一間公寓式醫院,不久後在深夜離奇墜樓身亡。坊間開始流傳該醫院是「幽靈醫院」。事後,余虹敏的攝影師在深夜頻頻接到詭異電話,撰稿人在一場離奇車禍後神志不清,而她的好友則神秘失蹤…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Mins photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears…

Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女模特余虹敏入住了一間公寓式醫院,不久後在深夜離奇墜樓身亡。坊間開始流傳該醫院是「幽靈醫院」。事後,余虹敏的攝影師在深夜頻頻接到詭異電話,撰稿人在一場離奇車禍後神志不清,而她的好友則神秘失蹤…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Mins photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 平靜的聖山村發生了一系列神秘事件,原本該下葬的屍體突然復活,而且拔足狂跑。全村馬上展開追查行動,但這時村中惡霸卻意外死亡,村長也失蹤。於是警察接手調查,但當謎底快要解開時,村幹部卻又有驚天大發現。到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前水牛城女警Megan與友人到深山露營時,意外目睹當地警長以私刑處決毒販。事跡敗露後,警長為滅口,竟將他們列為追殺目標。眾人試圖逃離,卻發現所有下山路徑已被封死。為徹底掩蓋罪行,警長公然調動私人武裝民..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a camping trip deep in the mountains, former Buffalo cop Megan and her friends stumble upon the local sheriff unlawfully executing a drug trafficker. Spotted and marked for death, they find every escape route sealed. To cover up his crime, the sheriff summons an armed militia to hunt them down—triggering a deadly chase with no way out.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天凌晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女模特余虹敏入住了一間公寓式醫院,不久後在深夜離奇墜樓身亡。坊間開始流傳該醫院是「幽靈醫院」。事後,余虹敏的攝影師在深夜頻頻接到詭異電話,撰稿人在一場離奇車禍後神志不清,而她的好友則神秘失蹤…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Mins photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸凌同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸凌,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洛陽無敵莊莊主失去了所有功力,於是請來侄兒與未婚妻一起護送黃金前往京城。在途中,他們遇到了一名神秘俠客,三人隨即聯手對抗盜匪,竭力保護黃金不被劫走。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancée to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名少女作盟誓要在一個沒有女權,甚或缺乏性自由的小漁村互相照顧一生。一位最終下嫁自己不認識的人,之後過著幸福快樂的日子。而另一位少女則慘遭許配給虐待成性的富家子,於是她唯有設法擺脫這個困境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huan Zhus ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitors ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they uni

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片是一部戰國時代歷史武俠片。故事描述,秦攻魏鄰趙國,魏信陵君與朱亥為救國,代魏王妃嬪如姬報父仇,以請姬盜魏王兵符,發兵救趙...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 妖精白素貞跟妹妹青青在凡間巧遇前世救命恩人書生許仙,後更以身相許給許仙。後和尚法海揭穿其身份並把這對苦命鴛鴦拆散...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 yea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 赤膽忠心的楊家將,世世代代為國而戰,子子孫孫為民而死,直戰到最後一員虎將楊宗保,不幸在金山之役中了埋伏,全營將士壯烈犧牲。楊宗保身負箭傷,被困金山,以身殉國。楊家滿門為保衛宋朝江山及替楊宗保報仇,在老祖母佘老太君的發起下,組成了一支楊家軍,誓與番邦周旋到底!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魯俊谷、張權、於洋三人乃沙煲兄弟,三人合力獲得寶物「雙面神」,不料卻給胡起尾注,將三人毒殺,獨吞「雙面神」。劉永、梁家仁及梁韻蕊是他們的後人,在不打不相識之下重逢,為了完成亡父的遺志,三人齊心向胡偷回寶物。韻蕊早已混入胡家中,色誘胡之子,作為內應查出「雙面神」之收藏地點。永與家仁則扮鬼扮馬,偷天換日
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kid

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李修賢是一摩托車行東主,曾是著名車手,惟一次意外中傷殘;他對學徒麥德羅甚為賞識,麥因李之啟蒙而在澳門賽車中奪標。李聞悉麥參與非法賽車,予以規勸,惟麥受盛名之累,欲罷不能…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Dannys help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. A

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片為徐蝦導演。 董驃, 錢小豪及蔣金飾扒手, 惟董失手被捕; 董出獄後裝南洋闊客, 隨錢及蔣返家, 因為想扮相古怪, 惹途人圍觀, 三人乘機施妙手, 更向盤問的保安隊長羅莽自詡身份特殊, 使羅躬身謝罪...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 仇連環在上海灘以拳頭打出天下,乃好勇鬥狠的典型人物。仇為了交際花沈菊芳不惜豁出性命,與著名幫會首腦之子及同伴展開連場明爭暗鬥,亦成為幫會爭奪地盤的嫁禍目標。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultim

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙春方曾於決鬥敗於龍帥之手下。七年後,龍帥為在賞燈大會上奪魁,往尋趙春方代為製造別緻燈籠。趙春方藉此暗中佈下復仇大計。龍帥之妻無固失蹤後,他驚聞有關人皮燈籠的傳說,並開始懷疑趙春方與失蹤事件有關......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long’s wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of huma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清廷高手駱一虎殺害反清義士陳貴,陳妻偕女小薇逃往廣龍鎮。鎮上兩家武館勢成水火,何教頭之侄家玉生性調皮,因營救小薇識破了老師為反清首領的身份。隨著至親與恩師相繼喪命於駱一虎之手,原本好勝頑皮的家玉憤而承擔起復仇重任,與清廷勢力展開生死決戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master’s identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幽默風趣的愛情喜劇,三個年青醫生常開道、史瑞科、蕭而可,被安排追求院長的三個女兒靈珍、靈珊、靈玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」來決定追求對象,他們的追女橋段層出不窮,用盡英雄救美、苦肉計、死纏爛打等愛情藥方,卻全部失靈,烏龍百出...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilar

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔山派秦五新劍術高超,連敗九十九名劍手,終在最後一擊敗在劍神手上。五新知其欠缺一柄寶劍,遂殺死著名鑄劍師老鷹,奪取稀世的「老鷹寶劍」。老鷹之子燕北悲痛萬分,矢誓報仇,不自量力挑戰五新,結果被打落懸崖之下...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-ma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有才華的女藝員蘭蘭與梅梅新加入「馬氏歌舞團」,蘭蘭與團主馬英不和。馬英在報紙匿名徵求女友,蘭蘭與他以匿名用書信往來,互生情愫。相約見面時,兩人膽怯退縮。歌舞團獲邀到日本表演,由馬英帶領,蘭蘭擔任女主角,二人的關係可否趁機會發展?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fan Ke discovers at his father’s deathbed that he has a half-brother, Wenlie, in Thailand. He goes to find Wenlie, who became a boxer to support his sick mother. Following their encounter, the two got involved in the underworld of boxing match gambli

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女俠明珠的師父遭黑虎幫歹徒偷襲重傷,臨終囑往找故友之女青青,探問失蹤財寶。歹徒偷聽得遺言,先去劫走青青,途遇「大羅劍俠」周應龍,怒打不平……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures befor

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family’s young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo’s stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is fr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,某寺青年僧人「瘋子」,性格瘋瘋癲癲,行為全不符僧人規範。該寺主持玄明方丈卻認為「瘋子」與佛有緣,並因應其性格與氣質,授以「癲羅漢拳」。「瘋子」有了武功後,動輒出拳傷人,方丈只得將其逐出寺門...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandits son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 的士司機阿發與少女阿霞相愛已久,但發有神經錯亂,霞為除心理負擔,忍痛分手; 發大鬧霞家並斷指示真心,令霞感動而復合。然發卻不務正業,令霞甚為反感;一次爭執間,發狂性大發,霞流產,再次離開發...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to becom

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部喜劇描述鄉下人阿牛來港後,因生性戇直而經常被壞人利用。阿牛嘗盡低下層社會的人情冷暖,最後更被判入獄!究竟天生樂觀的他,能否吉人天相?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《五毒天羅》是武林至毒之物,不知收藏何方。五毒教的蛇壇主,要找出天羅所在,獨霸武林,誤放消息,謂天羅已重現武林,江湖一片風聲鶴唳…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 追風刀劉鵬為采花大盜小天尊所殺,遺言徒弟盧漢去京師尋護龍刀復仇。途上,盧助康氏姊妹玉笙與玉簫退敵;抵京後又路見不平,救韓五嫂一命,因而結識韓的女兒牡丹...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiaos Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his frien

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 郭靖回到中原時,遇上黃蓉,二人一見鍾情雙雙墮入愛河。豈料,同時間歐陽克竟又向黃蓉提親。於是黃藥師決定以比武選婿,對決的勝方可娶女兒黃蓉為妻。經過一輪激戰,郭靖最後成功打敗歐陽克,奪得美人歸。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang’s father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally bea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正德皇帝江南遇李鳳,兩人互生情愫。臨別前正德聲言回京後會立即迎娶李鳳。一年後,當他派人接李鳳回宮時,她已病重,無法承受長途跋涉。雖然最終及時趕到,卻在心愛之人的懷裡離世……

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌舞團台柱陳君邁賦閒多時後,應徵當富家女梅倩如的司機,竟被誤傳戀情。倩如為查明流言的來源,假扮記者採訪歌舞團,期間君邁與倩如暗生好感,經過一番試探後,二人終一舞定情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕劍客沈秉義受命出任愛國組織「日月會」總舵主,誓要討伐勾結外敵、禍國殃民的大將軍。在捨身報國的征途中,他先後邂逅豪爽女俠與兩位美若天仙的維族公主。面對國仇家恨與三段纏綿深情,這位劍客陷入了情義兩難的抉擇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the Sun and Moon secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and tw

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wei Xiao Bao enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi. At the same time, he is assigned by a revolutionary group to steal the valuable Sutra of 42 Chapters, which Emperor Kang Xi himself is also seeking. Demonstrating keen intel

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事,講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘,二人一見鍾情,結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨,屢遭迫害,二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後,聞悉生母被壓華山,悲憤欲絕,藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神,劈山救母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家境富裕的大財主立帶男為填房,為了避免那不可靠的侄子奪取家產,他在病重前立下遺囑,更要求帶男將遺囑交給省城的另一侄子。當帶男這個年輕長輩遇上侄子及他的兒子時,更鬧出一連串的笑話。惠英紅更藉此奪第一屆香港電影金像獎影后。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this “young” auntie, the nephe

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 晉靈公寵信奸佞屠岸賈,時邊關告急,相國趙盾啟奏,反被屠岸賈挑撥,下令斬殺趙家三百餘口。幸程嬰抱莊姬之子趙武出走。屠下令殺全國男嬰以斷後患,程不惜以己子代替。趙長大,程以“雪冤圖”告之,殺一家三百口仇人乃屠岸賈,更安排他與母親相認......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江湖异人蕭大師鑄成寶劍「泪痕劍」,不料該劍顯現出凶兆,將會帶來武林浩劫,而他的親生子注定要死在此劍之下。蕭爲了使此劍不危害江湖,將它交給一位淡薄名利的弟子保管。數十年後該弟子把它傳給門徒小高,令其帶劍下山望化解江湖劫數。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial ar

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,陳太太有女潔玉及美玉,潔玉已工作,美玉仍求學。適逢陳家有空房出租,少奇來租,一談即合;潔玉三個姊姊,皆與租客結婚,所以潔玉表姊趙靜蘭之母決仿效陳家租房選婿。未幾,一醫科學生欣農來租房,趙母見他是理想快婿,忙出租。原來少奇與欣農是同學,少奇老成寡言,被潔玉、美玉視為怪人,欣農則只顧談戀愛…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述千金小姐劉月英與丫鬟春蘭同遊花田盛會,邂逅橋邊畫畫的落拓書生卞濟。春蘭眼見小姐芳心暗許,於是穿針引線,欲促成良緣,卻因老家僕錯認小霸王周通為卞濟,使小姐與卞濟情路波折重重。在經過一連串誤會與錯配後,結局乃皆大歡喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant’s confusion, threatening the couple’s union.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述千金小姐劉月英與丫鬟春蘭同遊花田盛會,邂逅橋邊畫畫的落拓書生卞濟。春蘭眼見小姐芳心暗許,於是穿針引線,欲促成良緣,卻因老家僕錯認小霸王周通為卞濟,使小姐與卞濟情路波折重重。在經過一連串誤會與錯配後,結局乃皆大歡喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant’s confusion, threatening the couple’s union.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述于唐朝年間,沙陀國主有十三義子,皆獲太保銜。姜大衛飾演的十三太保為戰場精英,因而引起兄弟間的嫉妒及挑撥離間,最後更演變成兄弟相殘。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince,  a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 威力無敵的兵器鴛鴦刀將要送給滿清的皇帝,卻不慎落入蕭中慧和袁冠南手裏。大內高手卓天雄於是出發追捕二人,誓要取回鴛鴦刀。大戰一觸即發,此刻鴛鴦刀的秘密也同被揭開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the bat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沈冰紅幼時目擊父母遭高允及結拜弟兄殺害,雙腳更被凍至殘廢;長大後練就非凡武功,矢志復仇。後冰紅與高允次子高天英結識,天英雖知冰紅為報仇而來,卻對她的遭遇非常同情,主動為她治好腳疾……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her familys massacre yea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七十二家房客租住一幢舊式的庭院,終日受潑辣的女房東和她卑鄙的丈夫的欺壓。一名勇於發聲的新房客出現,改變了租客的命運。他們合力對抗逼遷、抵制貪警,最終成功不讓房東出售家園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, defle

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李成鷹的父親被多年好友凌豪設計所殺。李成鷹從父親身上學會“十字鎖喉手”的秘技,誓要為死去的父親報仇。於是,他潛入凌家作護衛,期間也巧遇失散多年的兄長,兩兄弟聯手大戰殺父仇人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li Cheng Ying’s father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt “Shaolin Hand Lock” from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling’s house where he meets his long-lost brother

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來,接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結,圖取莊家產業,並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德!怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下,反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠,欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死,「西西」為救嬰兒,與野鼠作殊死搏鬥...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be app

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 玉面閻羅夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局金婁文之義子,後司馬鏢因偷取兩本功夫秘笈而傷夏之臉,並將師父殺死;夏抱初生女兒逃走。夏抱女入山修練,並傳武藝予女兒玉面飛狐,命她出山向司馬劫鏢報仇。後飛狐遭司馬擒住,幸為書生徐繩所救。飛狐回山后,父疑心其與徐有私情,把她關在地窟中...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆皇帝微服出巡,希望藉此了解百姓的生活需要,但卻碰上連串的奇遇,乾隆更被衙差關進牢獄,差點要被斬首…最後又有誰可拯救皇帝出困境?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年譚東獨自從大陸來港投靠祖父,因與黑社會人物徐豪結怨而遭陷害,迫於無奈偷渡到三藩市。東在唐人街飯店覓得工作,後來又因打抱不平而再牽涉入黑幫恩怨中。東更重遇徐豪,二人展開連場惡戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fig

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末年,光緒帝親政后,開始着手維新變法,惜改革觸犯了想保全自身富貴功名的官僚的阻擾。支持皇帝變法的康有為性格軟弱,堅持變法的譚嗣同難免浮躁,光緒深知自己的處境危險,於是企圖利用袁世凱去對付握有兵權的榮祿。但在關鍵時刻,袁世凱見風使舵卻向榮祿告了密,出賣了光緒...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu’s enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Impe

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若結合武林兩大魔頭,插翅虎及活閻王,的武功,他們必定獨霸武林,江湖又將有一輪腥風血雨。活閻王為促成這個邪惡聯盟,決將胞妹嫁給插翅虎。究竟最後二人之毒計會否得逞?誰可挽救一場武林浩劫?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King’s sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述飾花花公子的喬莊與好友楊帆,同時愛上胡燕妮,但楊成人之美。但喬因生殖力弱,故當胡懷孕時,就懷疑妻與楊有染…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女鬼劉阿翠鍾情以前鄰居馬素,欲與其結合,央求父親攜同金銀珠寶向馬提親,撮合一段人鬼姻緣,馬素年青憨直,不願與鬼為伍,堅決拒絕,實則彼暗戀已有男友之鄰居紅卜卜,阿翠洞悉其情,決定伺機行動。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

epg.programme_title_en: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆皇愛慕蘇州名妓三姑娘,為了朝夕幽會,竟然在青樓挖了一條地下通道直達紫禁城。青樓內外,乾隆神出鬼沒,嚇破臣下的膽子。乾隆在民間行俠仗義,更在賭坊大破賭局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor’s sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people

epg.programme_title_en: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆皇愛慕蘇州名妓三姑娘,為了朝夕幽會,竟然在青樓挖了一條地下通道直達紫禁城。青樓內外,乾隆神出鬼沒,嚇破臣下的膽子。乾隆在民間行俠仗義,更在賭坊大破賭局。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河東府教頭王陽受地方土紳孟二達陷害,成殺人疑犯,惟匿藏孟家任教頭。後王收好武青年周平為徒,卻惹孟不滿;原來周、孟兩大族為死敵,孟覺聘王當教頭,實乃養虎為患,遂唆使大盜「一條鞭」施以偷襲,幸王逃過大難,只是受了傷。孟家有寄居少女嘉嘉向不值孟氏所為,且對王很有好感,遂暗中援手...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong’s caught in the Mong’s territory and as punish

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 延續經典喜劇《72家房客》的成功,本片講述一羣住在香港唐樓的租客被發展商強行迫遷的故事。有些租客願意接受金錢賠償,但有些卻堅決反對。收購計劃最終又會否破壞鄰里間的和諧?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some res

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 楊家將被敵軍突襲,幾近全軍覆沒,僅存兩名兒子生還。楊家五子遂逃入少林寺,向少林僧人學習「狼牙棒法」,後來更創出「五郎八卦棍」。最終,楊五郎與眾寺僧聯手,為楊家將報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang’s escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and tea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名少女作盟誓要在一個沒有女權,甚或缺乏性自由的小漁村互相照顧一生。一位最終下嫁自己不認識的人,之後過著幸福快樂的日子。而另一位少女則慘遭許配給虐待成性的富家子,於是她唯有設法擺脫這個困境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武當弟子傅玉書殺害掌門後,嫁禍掌門之私生子雲飛揚,並接任掌門及下令要追殺他。雲飛揚誓要為父報仇,於是苦練天蠶功要打敗傅玉書。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief’s illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father’s death and learns the invincible silkwo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事,周丟棄劉明華,又去追獵呂綺美,劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚,呂遭殺死,警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人,一個一個的被殺死,嫌兇漸指向他,好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murd

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 總鏢頭李志山的妻子私通對頭人龍震天,並設計先偷飛龍刀,再殺害李志山及女兒小燕,幸好最後李氏父女成功逃脫。小燕長大後,更成為武功高強的女劍客,誓要為死去的母親報仇。直至一個偶然的機會,小燕遇到仍然在生的母親,才駭然發現真相,原來自己一直被父親的謊言所蒙騙。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Convoy Master Li’s wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li’s Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 泉州才子陳伯卿,邂逅潮州第一美人黃碧琚,心生傾慕;後伯卿得知兩人幼時曾定親,於是隱瞞身份,賣身黃府,作陪讀書僮,以接近碧琚。陝西巡撫之子林大雄,垂涎碧琚美色,強自下聘,欲娶之為妻;碧琚父貪財怕勢,不理家人反對,收下林家聘禮。伯卿得知碧琚已有婚配,刺激過度,一病不起…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lic

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陳氏家族失落的家傳之寶「金菩薩」隱藏了藏寶地點,秘密分別刻在三尊金菩薩內。保險員保羅意外地得到一尊金菩薩,另一尊則落在陳氏女兒美蘭手上。非法奪寶集團為尋寶藏下落追殺二人。保羅和美蘭為查明藏寶地點,歷盡艱辛,合力對抗,最終智破寶藏之謎,更勇破非法集團奪產的陰謀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A map indicating the location of the Chan’s family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chan’s daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 改編自著名中國神話《封神演義》中的章節,故事講述三千年前哪吒為救父母而犧牲自己的性命,後來因元神被置於蓮花內令他復活,哪吒更獲賜兩件寶物去解救因暴帝而受苦的百姓。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend “Investiture of the Gods”, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太空科學研究深所獲悉有來自冰河時代的人類所化之怪物將會危及地球上的所有人類。這批怪物兇悍異常,神通廣大,大有霸佔整個世界的野心。為了對付這批怪物,科學研究所所長劉英德以自己數十年來的研究心得把勇敢的科學研究員雷馬製造成萬能超人。中國超人開始了與怪物的戰鬥……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日本財閥小川,為奪燕姓所有之森林,勾結劣紳關甫淩,屢次對森林主人燕劍光遊說,均被拒絕。小川收買燕家內侄徐千偷取燕老鑰匙,潛入密室,盜取地契。後被燕老發覺,徐千竟將燕老痛毆致死。關甫淩有女月花,與燕家小主人子飛,本有嫁娶之約,燕老死後,但鑑於其父與日人相勾結,國恨家仇,兒女私情無法兼顧,只得示意決絕…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japan

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 聞蜚蛾自幼女扮男裝從父習武,後更考得秀才功名,堪稱文武全才。同窗好友杜子中與魏撰之雖與蜚蛾日夕相對,均不知其是女兒身。聞母見女兒年紀不小,不該再扮男裝,勸蜚蛾選撰之或子中為夫婿。不料蜚娥與二人情誼相同,一時無法抉擇,遂決定由天定奪,怎知陰差陽錯,選婿之箭落於撰之手中。蜚娥後悔不已,才知自己意屬子中…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General’s daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《遺落戰境》中,湯姆・克魯斯飾演一名在未來地球踏上救贖之旅的男子。由《創:光速戰記》導演執導,這是一部視覺震撼、直面過去以拯救人類的科幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Oblivion*, Tom Cruise stars as a man on a journey of redemption in a future Earth. Directed by the creator of *TRON: Legacy*, it’s a visually stunning sci-fi adventure about confronting the past to save humanity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位充滿希望的洛杉磯女演員與一位失憶女子結為好友。當她們共同尋找她身份的過程中,現實與幻覺交織,這是一場如夢似幻,關於野心、身份與好萊塢黑暗面的驚悚之旅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hopeful actress in Los Angeles befriends an amnesiac woman, and as they search for her identity, reality and illusion blur in a dreamlike thriller about ambition, identity, and Hollywoods dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚-克勞德·范·達美在冰球賽中孤身對抗恐怖分子,誓死拯救副總統並阻止體育館爆炸!時間緊迫,他能撐到比賽結束嗎?這就是《驚爆點》!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jean-Claude Van Damme battles terrorists at a hockey game to save the Vice President and stop a stadium bombing in this explosive thriller. Can he stall the game long enough? It’s Sudden Death!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席維斯・史特龍主演《???》,飾演一名失意英雄,在紐約市隧道崩塌之際,與時間賽跑營救受困通勤族。爆炸性的動作與懸疑氣氛,成就這部高風險災難驚悚片。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sylvester Stallone stars in Daylight as a fallen hero racing to rescue commuters trapped in a collapsing NYC tunnel. Explosive action and suspense power this high-stakes disaster thriller!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名在越戰中陣亡的士兵多年後被改造成半人半機的超級戰士。然而,當記憶逐漸甦醒,他們掙脫束縛,在昔日戰友之間展開了一場殘酷的對決。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two soldiers killed in Vietnam are revived years later as cyborg super-soldiers. But when memories return, they break free—setting up a brutal showdown between former comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚-克勞德・范達美主演本片,由動作大師吳宇森執導,一場緊張刺激的生死追擊即將展開——他對抗一群以獵殺人類為娛樂的致命組織。聯合主演包括藍斯・亨里克森與威爾福・布利姆利。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this John Woo action thriller where a man battles a deadly group that hunts humans for sport. Also features Lance Henriksen and Wilford Brimley.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了在一系列超級英雄電影宣告終結後重振自己的演藝事業,一名瘋狂的演員自編、自導、自演了一部百老匯舞台劇。沒想到,在首映禮上他試圖舉槍自盡後,這部戲竟然跌破眾人眼鏡地大獲成功
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an effort to jumpstart his career after his superhero movie franchise dies, a psychotic actor writes, directs, and stars in a broadway play that becomes an unlikely hit after he tries to shoots himself in the head during the premiere.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 戰火多年讓藍波身心俱疲,但他終於在一座寺院中找到了內心的平靜。當好友兼導師特勞特曼上校請求他協助執行一項前往阿富汗的最高機密任務時,藍波予以拒絕;然而當特勞特曼遭到擄捕後,藍波不得不重新考慮。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Combat has taken its toll on Rambo, but he’s finally begun to find inner peace in a monastery. When Rambo’s friend and mentor Col. Trautman asks for his help on a top secret mission to Afghanistan, Rambo declines but must reconsider when Trautman is

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1941年,轟炸東京後,一名美國飛行員在中國緊急降落。一位當地寡婦救了他,並冒著生命危險將他藏匿起來,以免他被日軍抓獲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1941, after bombing Tokyo, a US pilot makes an emergency landing in China. A local widow rescues him and risks everything to hide him from Japanese forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1937 年,一名中國武術家重返上海,發現師父遇害、武館遭日軍欺壓,於是挺身而出。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Misanthropic worker Orson detests his lazy colleagues. He finds a secret, magical office that boosts his productivity and status, but his coworkers can’t see the room and grow to resent his success.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jean-Claude Van Damme battles terrorists at a hockey game to save the Vice President and stop a stadium bombing in this explosive thriller. Can he stall the game long enough? It’s Sudden Death!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一對亡命鴛鴦那段光鮮亮麗卻時而致命的冒險,演變成充滿背叛、死裡逃生、虛假身分以及令人頭昏眼花的愛情糾葛迷宮時,他們才終於意識到,此時此刻唯一能指望的,就只有彼此了。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a fugitive couples glamorous and sometimes deadly adventure erupts into a maze of double-crosses, close escapes, false identities, and head-spinning romantic snafus, they come to realize that all they can count on is each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tom Cruise stars in The Mummy, a thrilling new take on the legend. When an ancient queen awakens in modern times, she unleashes a terrifying force, sparking a battle across continents.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A shipping magnate hires four experts from various fields to investigate what happened to his ships that went missing in the Bermuda Triangle. The team discovers a threat that might unravel time itself and cause the world to end.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After his partner Tom Wynne and family are killed by the infamous and elusive assassin Rogue (Jet Li), FBI agent Jack Crawford (Jason Statham) becomes obsessed with revenge as his world unravels into a vortex of guilt and betrayal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對從小失散的同卵雙胞胎——一位是居住在紐約的音樂家,另一位是生活在香港的技工——多年後因音樂家的演奏會行程來到香港,意外重逢,引發一連串錯綜有趣的事件。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Identical twins – a musician living in New York, and a mechanic living in Hong Kong – are separated in childhood but are unexpectedly reunited years later when the musician travels to Hong Kong for a concert.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a deadly new strain of an unknown virus infects a plane on its way to Los Angeles, CDC Dr. Kayla Martin and her team must battle political obstacles, conspiracy theorists, and an escape of the quarantined survivors.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tom Cruise stars in The Mummy, a thrilling new take on the legend. When an ancient queen awakens in modern times, she unleashes a terrifying force, sparking a battle across continents.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Wanted, a slacker is recruited by a secret assassin fraternity, uncovering hidden powers and dark truths as he trains under elite killers, including Angelina Jolie and Morgan Freeman.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1941, after bombing Tokyo, a US pilot makes an emergency landing in China. A local widow rescues him and risks everything to hide him from Japanese forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After his partner Tom Wynne and family are killed by the infamous and elusive assassin Rogue (Jet Li), FBI agent Jack Crawford (Jason Statham) becomes obsessed with revenge as his world unravels into a vortex of guilt and betrayal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《反恐戰場》中,傑米福克斯率領一支菁英FBI小組前往沙烏地阿拉伯追捕一名恐怖分子——這是一場文化與正義的緊張交鋒。該片由彼得柏格執導,麥可曼監製。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jamie Foxx leads an elite FBI team to hunt a terrorist in Saudi Arabia in The Kingdom—a tense clash of cultures and justice, directed by Peter Berg and produced by Michael Mann.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《邁阿密風雲》中,由傑米・福克斯與柯林・法洛飾演的臥底警探深入毒品世界,在危險、誘惑與犯罪中周旋。這部風格鮮明、緊張刺激的作品重新演繹經典影集,同時由鞏俐聯袂主演。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Miami Vice, undercover detectives played by Jamie Foxx and Colin Farrell navigate danger, crime, and seduction in a gritty, stylish update of the iconic TV series. Also stars Gong Li.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《刺客聯盟》中,一名廢青被神秘刺客組織招募,在菁英殺手的訓練下(包括安潔莉娜・裘莉與摩根・費里曼),他覺醒潛藏力量,也一步步揭開背後黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Wanted, a slacker is recruited by a secret assassin fraternity, uncovering hidden powers and dark truths as he trains under elite killers, including Angelina Jolie and Morgan Freeman.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《遺落戰境》中,湯姆・克魯斯飾演一名在未來地球踏上救贖之旅的男子。由《創:光速戰記》導演執導,這是一部視覺震撼、直面過去以拯救人類的科幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Oblivion*, Tom Cruise stars as a man on a journey of redemption in a future Earth. Directed by the creator of *TRON: Legacy*, it’s a visually stunning sci-fi adventure about confronting the past to save humanity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2084年,建築工人道格拉斯·奎德前往雷卡爾星球,進行一次虛擬的火星之旅——但這趟旅程卻意外喚醒被封存的記憶,將他捲入一場致命叛亂與特工身份的過去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2084, construction worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall for a virtual Mars vacation—but the procedure unlocks hidden memories, thrusting him into a deadly rebellion and a secret-agent past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2084年,建築工人道格拉斯·奎德前往雷卡爾星球,進行一次虛擬的火星之旅——但這趟旅程卻意外喚醒被封存的記憶,將他捲入一場致命叛亂與特工身份的過去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2084, construction worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall for a virtual Mars vacation—but the procedure unlocks hidden memories, thrusting him into a deadly rebellion and a secret-agent past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚-克勞德・范達美主演本片,由動作大師吳宇森執導,一場緊張刺激的生死追擊即將展開——他對抗一群以獵殺人類為娛樂的致命組織。聯合主演包括藍斯・亨里克森與威爾福・布利姆利。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this John Woo action thriller where a man battles a deadly group that hunts humans for sport. Also features Lance Henriksen and Wilford Brimley.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一對亡命鴛鴦那段光鮮亮麗卻時而致命的冒險,演變成充滿背叛、死裡逃生、虛假身分以及令人頭昏眼花的愛情糾葛迷宮時,他們才終於意識到,此時此刻唯一能指望的,就只有彼此了。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席維斯・史特龍主演《???》,飾演一名失意英雄,在紐約市隧道崩塌之際,與時間賽跑營救受困通勤族。爆炸性的動作與懸疑氣氛,成就這部高風險災難驚悚片。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sylvester Stallone stars in Daylight as a fallen hero racing to rescue commuters trapped in a collapsing NYC tunnel. Explosive action and suspense power this high-stakes disaster thriller!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1872年,一位英國發明家、一位中國小偷和一位法國藝術家出發,用80天完成環球航行。他們通過海陸空和滾軸溜冰,爭分奪秒回到起點。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is 1872, and a British inventor, a Chinese thief and a French artist set off to circumnavigate the globe in 80 days. They travel by land, air, sea, and in-line skates in order to beat the clock and finish where they started.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湯姆克魯斯主演的《神鬼傳奇》以驚險刺激的全新視角詮釋了這段傳奇故事。一位古代女王在現代甦醒,釋放出一股可怕的力量,引發了一場橫跨大洲的戰爭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tom Cruise stars in The Mummy, a thrilling new take on the legend. When an ancient queen awakens in modern times, she unleashes a terrifying force, sparking a battle across continents.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一對亡命鴛鴦那段光鮮亮麗卻時而致命的冒險,演變成充滿背叛、死裡逃生、虛假身分以及令人頭昏眼花的愛情糾葛迷宮時,他們才終於意識到,此時此刻唯一能指望的,就只有彼此了。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1941年,轟炸東京後,一名美國飛行員在中國緊急降落。一位當地寡婦救了他,並冒著生命危險將他藏匿起來,以免他被日軍抓獲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1941, after bombing Tokyo, a US pilot makes an emergency landing in China. A local widow rescues him and risks everything to hide him from Japanese forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1937 年,一名中國武術家重返上海,發現師父遇害、武館遭日軍欺壓,於是挺身而出。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

epg.programme_title_en: The Odyssey: The Making Of An Epic
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 導演克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)誠邀您進入《奧德賽》(The Odyssey)的世界。這部由他執導的神話動作史詩巨作改編自荷馬史詩,也是首部完全使用 IMAX 電影攝影機拍攝的電影。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Director Christopher Nolan invites you into the world of The Odyssey, his mythic action epic of Homer’s saga, and the first film shot entirely with IMAX Film Cameras.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在充斥著貪腐、謀殺以及影星光環的繁華背後,三名警官誓死奮戰,只為揭開一起殘忍連環慘案背後的駭人真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amidst corruption, murder and the glamour of famous movie stars, three police officer fight to uncover the truth of a brutal mass murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 羅素克洛在雷德利史考特的史詩巨制《羅賓漢》中飾演羅賓漢——在這段傳奇中,他奮起對抗腐敗,點燃反叛之火,讓一位卑微的亡命之徒化身為永恆的自由象徵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Russell Crowe stars as Robin Hood in Ridley Scott’s epic reimagining—fighting corruption and sparking a rebellion that turns a humble outlaw into a timeless symbol of freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hopeful actress in Los Angeles befriends an amnesiac woman, and as they search for her identity, reality and illusion blur in a dreamlike thriller about ambition, identity, and Hollywoods dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對從小失散的同卵雙胞胎——一位是居住在紐約的音樂家,另一位是生活在香港的技工——多年後因音樂家的演奏會行程來到香港,意外重逢,引發一連串錯綜有趣的事件。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Identical twins – a musician living in New York, and a mechanic living in Hong Kong – are separated in childhood but are unexpectedly reunited years later when the musician travels to Hong Kong for a concert.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在他的搭檔湯姆韋恩和家人被臭名昭彰且難以捉摸的刺客羅格(李連杰)殺害後,聯邦調查局特工約翰克勞佛(傑森斯坦森)開始沉迷於報復,因為他的世界陷入了內疚和背叛的漩渦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After his partner Tom Wynne and family are killed by the infamous and elusive assassin Rogue (Jet Li), FBI agent Jack Crawford (Jason Statham) becomes obsessed with revenge as his world unravels into a vortex of guilt and betrayal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1941年,轟炸東京後,一名美國飛行員在中國緊急降落。一位當地寡婦救了他,並冒著生命危險將他藏匿起來,以免他被日軍抓獲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1941, after bombing Tokyo, a US pilot makes an emergency landing in China. A local widow rescues him and risks everything to hide him from Japanese forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《恐怖角》中,勞勃・狄尼洛飾演一名心懷怨恨的前科犯,對其昔日律師(尼克・諾特飾)展開步步進逼的跟蹤報復。由馬丁・史柯西斯執導,這部充滿張力的驚悚片是令人不寒而慄的經典重拍之作。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Cape Fear, Robert De Niro plays a vengeful ex-con stalking his former lawyer, played by Nick Nolte. Directed by Martin Scorsese, this suspense-filled thriller is a chilling classic remake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了在一系列超級英雄電影宣告終結後重振自己的演藝事業,一名瘋狂的演員自編、自導、自演了一部百老匯舞台劇。沒想到,在首映禮上他試圖舉槍自盡後,這部戲竟然跌破眾人眼鏡地大獲成功

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, many sects use sleazy scams to deceive the public. Young maiden Sun Jin, armed escort Li, and the kung fu expert Yang, join forces to uncover the truth behind the widespread deception. However, they soon discover the hidden secrets of Yang and Li. Who amongst them is the true villain?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Su Wen Xing aspires to take over the familys textile shop, but loses the control to his cousin. To prove himself, he sets out on a journey to find his own success but faces repeated setbacks. In despair, he reconnects with an old classmate who collaborates with him on a business venture, resulting in a series of amusing and chaotic escapades.
