epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾.阿克拉波維奇--一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師.隨著深入了解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard travel to Slovenia to meet Igor Akrapovič. Igor’s company is an exhaust engineer known by MotoGP legends. As they learn from Igor, Arch will collaborate with him on a new project.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬.布拉德利--她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達.透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂.羅德裡格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員.馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾.阿克拉波維奇--一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師.隨著深入了解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力.從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會.在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感.他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士,溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.programme_title_tc: 克林伊斯威特:自得其樂
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇連伊士活是一個演員,導演和慈善家.從典型的西方偶像,到磨練他的技藝和關懷的個性.這就是他波瀾壯闊的人生故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Clint Eastwood, Actor, director and philanthropist. From being the quintessential western icon, to honing his artistic skills and caring persona. This is his magnificent story.

epg.programme_title_tc: 拉斐爾納達爾:紅土球王
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片深入探討網球傳奇拉斐爾納達爾的人生,探索他從神童成長為全球巨星的歷程.透過眾多勝利和挑戰揭示拿度在球場內外所貢獻的遺產.(V374)
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary delves into the life of tennis legend Rafael Nadal, exploring his journey from a young prodigy to a global icon. Through triumphs and challenges, it reveals the dedication that defines Nadal’s legacy on and off the court.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從地下俱樂部到全球巨星,《女神卡卡:為舞而生》探索這位重新定義音樂,時尚與名聲的流行偶像勢不可擋的崛起之路.在勝利與挫折交織的人生中,見證卡卡如何以舞步迎戰挑戰,並最終勝出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From underground clubs to global superstardom, Lady Gaga: Dance or Die explores the unstoppable rise of the pop icon who redefined music, fashion, and fame. Through triumphs and tribulations, witness how Gaga danced through life’s challenges - and wo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在我們知道為何加密貨幣是何等大事,而我們在本集將認識紐西蘭最大的加密貨幣成功故事之一背後的家族.我們將破除一些加密神話並介紹如何參與的入門.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Now we know why Crypto is such a big deal, through this episode we』ll meet the family behind one of NZ’s biggest Crypto success stories. We』ll dispel some crypto myths and cover the basics of how to get on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在紐西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫來到歷史名城普利托利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren stops off at the historic city of Pretoria, where he visits the local farmers markets and cooks Koeksisters - South African sticky donuts - with Pastry Chef Nonkosi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰尼斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維託小鎮.導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車 遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 起司大師阿弗林・普裡斯汀的起司探險之旅從阿爾卑斯山國瑞士展開,這裡是格魯耶爾與經典孔洞艾門塔起司的故鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheese Master Afrim Pristine begins his cheese expedition in the Alpine country of Switzerland, home of iconic classics like Gruyere and holey Swiss Emmental.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在法國,吃起司幾乎是一項全民嗜好.阿弗林走訪巴黎到諾曼第,探索全國各地悠久而豐富的起司製作歷史.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eating cheese is a national pastime in France. Here, Afrim uncovers the rich histories of cheesemaking across the country from Paris to Normandy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從地下俱樂部到全球巨星,《女神卡卡:為舞而生》探索這位重新定義音樂,時尚與名聲的流行偶像勢不可擋的崛起之路.在勝利與挫折交織的人生中,見證卡卡如何以舞步迎戰挑戰,並最終勝出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From underground clubs to global superstardom, Lady Gaga: Dance or Die explores the unstoppable rise of the pop icon who redefined music, fashion, and fame. Through triumphs and tribulations, witness how Gaga danced through life’s challenges - and wo

epg.programme_title_tc: 瑪麗亞凱莉:毅力與魅力
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪麗亞.凱莉的人生宛如童話般的灰姑娘故事.至尊歌后,聖誕女王,熱心公益的慈善家--她已售出超過 2.2 億張唱片,並推出史上最暢銷的聖誕專輯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Cinderella story of sorts, Mariah Carey. Songbird Supreme. Queen of Christmas. Dedicated philanthropist. Mariah has sold over 220 million records and released the best-selling Christmas album ever.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅賓·威廉斯:笑容下的淚
epg.programme_title_en: Robin Williams: Laugh Until You Cry
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這位喜劇泰鬥有著令人驚嘆的頭腦,還有一系列讓我們嘖嘖稱奇的才華.他的故事激勵我們看穿那些看似擁有完美人生的人的面具. 他的精神將一直承傳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The comic genius with an electric mind, with a range of talent that left us breathless. His story inspires us to look past the mask of those people who seem to have a perfect life. His legacy lives on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來臨.北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物,配偶,並組織家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring comes to the Dales and North York Moors National Parks, the season when the parks animals must find food, a mate and raise a family.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備.至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睪酮的氣息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is on hold as summer continues, with unexpectedly balmy conditions throwing a life line to the roe deer as they prepare for the winter ahead. For other animals, mating season has arrived, making for a testosterone-fuelled time at Ravenscar Bea

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間.新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite its delayed arrival, for the Grey Seals at Ravenscar Beach winter means it is time to give birth. The newborn pups are now on the fast track to adulthood, with just three weeks to gain as much weight as possible before their mothers move on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eating cheese is a national pastime in France. Here, Afrim uncovers the rich histories of cheesemaking across the country from Paris to Normandy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林深入加拿大魁北克的濃厚起司傳統,當地家族乳酪坊的技藝世代相傳,延續至今.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes in the cheesy traditions of la belle province, Quebec, where family fromageries』 traditions have been passed on through generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林在自己的家鄉多倫多展開一場迷你環球起司之旅,這座城市是世界上最多元且充滿文化魅力的地方之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes a mini cheese trip around the world in his own backyard, Toronto, one of the most diverse and cultural cities on the planet.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅賓·威廉斯:笑容下的淚
epg.programme_title_en: Robin Williams: Laugh Until You Cry
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這位喜劇泰鬥有著令人驚嘆的頭腦,還有一系列讓我們嘖嘖稱奇的才華.他的故事激勵我們看穿那些看似擁有完美人生的人的面具. 他的精神將一直承傳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The comic genius with an electric mind, with a range of talent that left us breathless. His story inspires us to look past the mask of those people who seem to have a perfect life. His legacy lives on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬修派瑞因飾演昌德賓一角而深受觀眾喜愛,作為一位值得珍惜的老友和人,人們通過強調他在片場內外的喜劇遺產和個人奮鬥的珍藏片段緬懷他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matthew Perry, beloved for his role as Chandler Bing, is remembered through archive footage highlighting his comedic legacy and personal struggles, both on and off set, as a cherished friend and human being.

epg.programme_title_en: John Cena: Champion Of The Ring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊先拿在繼巨石強森- 狄維莊遜後轉戰好萊塢之前,叱吒摔角界十多年.無論是演戲還是摔跤,他都遵守自己的座右銘:努力,忠誠,尊重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John Cena dominated wrestling for over a decade before transitioning to Hollywood, following Dwayne The Rock Johnson. Whether acting or wrestling, he lives by his mantra: Hustle, Loyalty, and Respect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片帶領觀眾深入且全面地回顧萊昂內爾・梅西的非凡職業生涯--從阿根廷羅薩裡奧的平凡起點,到成為全球足球傳奇巨星的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary offers an intimate and comprehensive journey through the extraordinary career of Lionel Messi - from his humble beginnings in Rosario, Argentina, to becoming a global football icon.

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從小鎮天才到世界第一,這部紀錄片記錄了穆雷追求卓越的堅持,與傷病的搏鬥,以及他作為網壇最具啟發性人物之一的永恆傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town prodigy to World No. 1, Andy Murray: Game Set Match chronicles his relentless pursuit of greatness, his battles with injury, and his enduring legacy as one of tenniss most inspiring figures.

epg.programme_title_tc: 珍妮佛·羅培茲:三重威脅
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進珍妮花露柏絲的世界,她是娛樂事業的主導人物,從卑微出身到成為一線明星的歷程大大地鼓舞人心.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Jennifer Lopez, a dominant figure in the entertainment industry whose journey from humble beginnings to A-list stardom is nothing short of inspirational.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬治・克隆尼以迷人外型與自然魅力聞名,但他的傳奇不僅止於銀幕.娛樂之外,他更是慈善與人道精神的代表人物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: George Clooney might be celebrated for his striking looks and effortless charisma, but his legacy goes far beyond the allure of Hollywood. Beyond entertainment, Clooney stands as a beacon of philanthropy.

epg.programme_title_en: Johnny Depp: The Art Of Transformation
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員,製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名.儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞臺上迎來強勢回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny Depp is an American actor, producer and musician known for his film roles and turbulent personal life. Despite set backs. Depp has remained active in the arts, marking a comeback on the international stage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪瑪丹娜第一任經理人卡繆巴龐,舞者卡爾頓威爾邦,艾薇塔工作室執行官羅倫萊等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Madonna’s first manager Camille Barbone, dancer Carlton Wilborn, Evita studio executive Lauren Lloyd, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪與羅賓威廉斯在《暴雨驕陽》聯合主演的基爾漢臣,《外星驕客》編劇大衛米施,好友兼喜劇演員域克奧華頓等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Robin Williams』 Dead Poets Society co-star Gale Hansen, Mork  Mindy writer David Misch, friend and comedian Rick Overton, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Jennifer Lopez, a dominant figure in the entertainment industry whose journey from humble beginnings to A-list stardom is nothing short of inspirational.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林在自己的家鄉多倫多展開一場迷你環球起司之旅,這座城市是世界上最多元且充滿文化魅力的地方之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes a mini cheese trip around the world in his own backyard, Toronto, one of the most diverse and cultural cities on the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的起司尋味之旅來到希臘--菲達起司的發源地,起司文化可追溯至數千年前的古老傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s cheese quest continues in Greece, the motherland of Feta, and where cheese culture dates back thousands of years in ancient practices.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由支持在地的精神所驅動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s final stop is beautiful British Columbia, Canada’s West coast, where an innovative cheese culture is driven by its 『support local』 mentality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在我們知道為何加密貨幣是何等大事,而我們在本集將認識紐西蘭最大的加密貨幣成功故事之一背後的家族.我們將破除一些加密神話並介紹如何參與的入門.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Now we know why Crypto is such a big deal, through this episode we』ll meet the family behind one of NZ’s biggest Crypto success stories. We』ll dispel some crypto myths and cover the basics of how to get on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在紐西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感.他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士,溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明把過去幾週所學到的知識融匯貫通,為包括他母親在內的一些貴客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw gathers what he has learned over the past few weeks to serve up an impressive five-course banquet dinner to some distinguished guests, including his mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Jim Carrey’s The Mask director Chuck Russell, The Duck Factory co-star Teresa Ganzel, Man On The Moon executive producer Michael Hausman, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感.他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士,溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明把過去幾週所學到的知識融匯貫通,為包括他母親在內的一些貴客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw gathers what he has learned over the past few weeks to serve up an impressive five-course banquet dinner to some distinguished guests, including his mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備.至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睪酮的氣息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is on hold as summer continues, with unexpectedly balmy conditions throwing a life line to the roe deer as they prepare for the winter ahead. For other animals, mating season has arrived, making for a testosterone-fuelled time at Ravenscar Bea

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間.新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite its delayed arrival, for the Grey Seals at Ravenscar Beach winter means it is time to give birth. The newborn pups are now on the fast track to adulthood, with just three weeks to gain as much weight as possible before their mothers move on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由支持在地的精神所驅動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s final stop is beautiful British Columbia, Canada’s West coast, where an innovative cheese culture is driven by its 『support local』 mentality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪,歷史和個人之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉.徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化,國際化,全球化的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾.阿克拉波維奇--一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師.隨著深入了解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard travel to Slovenia to meet Igor Akrapovič. Igor’s company is an exhaust engineer known by MotoGP legends. As they learn from Igor, Arch will collaborate with him on a new project.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬.布拉德利--她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達.透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂.羅德裡格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員.馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築--從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索--理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《博物館的秘密》帶觀眾深入倫敦 VA 博物館幕後,展出康斯特勃的版畫,桑迪・鮑威爾的簽名西裝,法貝熱的英國作品,以及由首位 Beano 女性藝術家蘿拉・豪威爾創作的新漫畫插圖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secrets of the Museum goes behind the scenes at the VA, featuring Constables prints, Sandy Powells autographed suit, Fabergés British works, and new Beano artwork by Laura Howell, the first female Beano artist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪雪兒《施活的遭遇》導演米高候斯曼,神尼及雪兒經理哈維克斯基,影評人柯克懇尼咳等.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Cher’s Silkwood producer Michael Hausman, Sonny  Cher manager Harvey Kresky, film critic Kirk Honeycutt, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪妮可基嫚的演技教練蘇珊伯臣,《不惜一切》監製莊拿汾塔別林,聲學導師瑪莉錫查乾等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Nicole Kidman’s acting coach Susan Batson, To Die For executive producer Jonathan Taplin, voice teacher Mary Setrakian, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪阿諾史瓦辛格《 蒸發密令》導演漆黑羅素,《霸王神劍》共同主演莎拉道格拉斯 ,《大力神在紐約》導演阿瑟艾倫賽道曼等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Arnold Schwarzenegger’s Eraser director Chuck Russell, Conan The Destroyer co-star Sarah Douglas, Hercules In New York director Arthur Allan Seidelman, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德獲得前所未有的機會,進入全球最神秘的藝術作品之一--詹姆斯.特瑞爾的〈羅登火山口〉.在這座火山口中,藝術以光與宇宙為題展開探索.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard are given unprecedented access to one of the world’s most guarded artworks: James Turrell’s Roden Crater. Inside the volcanic crater, the art explores the use of light and the cosmos.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪.貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化.歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omar’s FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, he』ll create a boot inspired by ARCH.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂.羅德裡格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員.馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會.在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 起司大師阿弗林・普裡斯汀的起司探險之旅從阿爾卑斯山國瑞士展開,這裡是格魯耶爾與經典孔洞艾門塔起司的故鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheese Master Afrim Pristine begins his cheese expedition in the Alpine country of Switzerland, home of iconic classics like Gruyere and holey Swiss Emmental.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在法國,吃起司幾乎是一項全民嗜好.阿弗林走訪巴黎到諾曼第,探索全國各地悠久而豐富的起司製作歷史.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eating cheese is a national pastime in France. Here, Afrim uncovers the rich histories of cheesemaking across the country from Paris to Normandy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林深入加拿大魁北克的濃厚起司傳統,當地家族乳酪坊的技藝世代相傳,延續至今.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes in the cheesy traditions of la belle province, Quebec, where family fromageries』 traditions have been passed on through generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林在自己的家鄉多倫多展開一場迷你環球起司之旅,這座城市是世界上最多元且充滿文化魅力的地方之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes a mini cheese trip around the world in his own backyard, Toronto, one of the most diverse and cultural cities on the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明把過去幾週所學到的知識融匯貫通,為包括他母親在內的一些貴客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw gathers what he has learned over the past few weeks to serve up an impressive five-course banquet dinner to some distinguished guests, including his mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的起司尋味之旅來到希臘--菲達起司的發源地,起司文化可追溯至數千年前的古老傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s cheese quest continues in Greece, the motherland of Feta, and where cheese culture dates back thousands of years in ancient practices.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由支持在地的精神所驅動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s final stop is beautiful British Columbia, Canada’s West coast, where an innovative cheese culture is driven by its 『support local』 mentality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪,歷史和個人之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉.徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化,國際化,全球化的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會.在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備.至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睪酮的氣息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is on hold as summer continues, with unexpectedly balmy conditions throwing a life line to the roe deer as they prepare for the winter ahead. For other animals, mating season has arrived, making for a testosterone-fuelled time at Ravenscar Bea

epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間.新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite its delayed arrival, for the Grey Seals at Ravenscar Beach winter means it is time to give birth. The newborn pups are now on the fast track to adulthood, with just three weeks to gain as much weight as possible before their mothers move on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會.在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺.但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷,最貧瘠的環境中繁衍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報.動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙.牠們必須學習覓食,保護家園,吸引配偶,養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.託森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築--從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索--理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《博物館的秘密》帶觀眾深入倫敦 VA 博物館幕後,展出康斯特勃的版畫,桑迪・鮑威爾的簽名西裝,法貝熱的英國作品,以及由首位 Beano 女性藝術家蘿拉・豪威爾創作的新漫畫插圖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secrets of the Museum goes behind the scenes at the VA, featuring Constables prints, Sandy Powells autographed suit, Fabergés British works, and new Beano artwork by Laura Howell, the first female Beano artist.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰.這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明把過去幾週所學到的知識融匯貫通,為包括他母親在內的一些貴客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw gathers what he has learned over the past few weeks to serve up an impressive five-course banquet dinner to some distinguished guests, including his mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.programme_title_en: John Cena: Champion Of The Ring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊先拿在繼巨石強森- 狄維莊遜後轉戰好萊塢之前,叱吒摔角界十多年.無論是演戲還是摔跤,他都遵守自己的座右銘:努力,忠誠,尊重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John Cena dominated wrestling for over a decade before transitioning to Hollywood, following Dwayne The Rock Johnson. Whether acting or wrestling, he lives by his mantra: Hustle, Loyalty, and Respect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪瑪丹娜第一任經理人卡繆巴龐,舞者卡爾頓威爾邦,艾薇塔工作室執行官羅倫萊等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Madonna’s first manager Camille Barbone, dancer Carlton Wilborn, Evita studio executive Lauren Lloyd, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 專訪與羅賓威廉斯在《暴雨驕陽》聯合主演的基爾漢臣,《外星驕客》編劇大衛米施,好友兼喜劇演員域克奧華頓等人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Robin Williams』 Dead Poets Society co-star Gale Hansen, Mork  Mindy writer David Misch, friend and comedian Rick Overton, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.programme_title_tc: Sons of Perdition Leaving The Cult

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The ultimate coming-of-age movie. With a combined age of almost 300, Hetty, Rose and Alison love to share their concerns on everything from terrorism and global warming to sex, death and the meaning of life. The Time of Their Lives reveals the everyday mystery of how very old people experience life and the intense challenges that old age brings. Like first-hand witnesses reporting back from the edge of their own mortality, Hetty, Rose and Alison tell us things which are never spoken of.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is about the stories about people who lost everything in natural disasters.  Every year people lost their homes and many rebuild the exact same way.  Most people had no idea if their insurance will actually get them whole again after a major disaster.  If they have to evacuate, and their house is destroyed, many of the things that were lost can never be replaced.  When you watch The Last House Stanidng you will meet people who are living the nightmare, and it doesn't have to be this way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The ultimate coming-of-age movie. With a combined age of almost 300, Hetty, Rose and Alison love to share their concerns on everything from terrorism and global warming to sex, death and the meaning of life. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Greek Island of Lemnos is one of the lesser-known secrets of the northern Aegean, but that’s exactly why it’s a great place to explore. epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries. 

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

Starting inland she explores some of the remains of ancient civilisations and experiences some incredible views of Alacati and the surrounding areas. After a brief stop off for some exquisite wine, she heads to the nearby coastal town of Cesme for some further exploring and puts herself to the test by having a go at the famous local sport of Wind Surfing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries. 

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Doused in heritage with old hamlets, drowsy villages and towns studding its lush green hills, Southern France’s Occitania region only officially come into being in 2016 with the pairing of Languedoc-Roussillon and the Midi-Pyrenees. The two historically Occitan regions are blessed with colour, tranquility, and a wealth of UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Food and drink are still approached with reverence in the region, and a whistle stop tour around four different departments of the Midi Pyrenees; Tarn, Gers, Tarn-et-Garonne and Haute Garonne gives you plenty of opportunity to experience some of its best gastronomy, as Katy Dartford discovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is all excited for the Tandoori Party.

The world loves to BBQ and India has some of the oldest forms – Tandoori cooking. Samira takes a fresh approach to Tandoori cuisine and the grill that goes back thousands of years. 

The Episode starts off with a visit to a Street Tandoori hub that makes Kababs that have a cult following of their own. Samira ends up taking over grill, learns the art of Tandoori breads and how can any Tandoori feast be complete without the Pièce de résistance, The Tandoori Chicken and a Party!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Join John Plaskett as he heads deep into the Pyrenees Mountains in Catalonia. Normally a popular destination during the winter months we thought we’d check it out during the summer. Experience the amazing views as John hikes through national parks and beautiful gorges. But it’s not just a place for trekking as he also experiences cycling on part of the Tour de France route and enjoys the thrills of white-water rafting.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The resort of Somabay, on Egypt’s Red Sea coast, may have only been around for a few years, but it’s already making a big impression. With a choice of top-class hotel, a championship golf course, and one of the biggest spa facilities in the whole of Africa, this is the ultimate getaway destination. There is also a vast private kite-surfing beach, diving and snorkelling facilities, and seemingly endless sandy beaches lapped by the warm waters of the Red Sea. No wonder presenter Trevor Claringbold describes it as one of his favourite destinations!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries. 

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

From Africa to Asia, they are targeted for their meat and immense fins.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The creative production team goes around Taiwan in search of inspiring stories in the country. Get to know more unique individuals and discover the true spirit of Taiwan.

epg.episode_synopsis_en:
Creating a brand-new interactive ATM that combined with puzzle solving and daily life! Guests can win money by taking three rounds of intellectual challenges from the ATM, turn wisdom into money!
Futuristic program scenes with video game clearing concept, where challengers engage in the intellectual competition to switch on the ATM. Those who won goes to the ultimate challenge. Host Hu Gua, co-host Sandra and the elite challengers will stay together, built up a whole new competition between technology and wisdom!

epg.programme_title_tc: 香港早晨[粵] 及 交通消息[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Good Morning Hong Kong[Can] and Traffic Report[Can]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義為圓當賽車手夢想私下學車，但因看到花手中公仔而失控撞車入院，花取笑義技術差勁，更揭發義受傷原因。喜於是道出義因童年陰影，致每次看到這種公仔時，必定會大失常性，花聽後，內心難安，決定助有義克服陰影。
雪寧想到很多事情都沒有改變，疑惑究竟是否該執意與張遮在一起。尤夫人為芳吟籌謀婚事，想藉此抵債，芳吟極不情願；呂顯想到辦法協助芳吟脫離尤家。謝危先發制人，直接對薛遠談及定非的事，讓薛遠無法下手對付自己…

epg.programme_title_tc: 交易現場[粵] 及 卓正醫療呈獻：全家健康攻略[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Inside the Stock Exchange[Can] and Distinct HealthCare Presents: The Family Health Guide[Can]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集以醋入饌！來自台灣的天下第一薑有甚麼來頭？炮製薑醋關鍵在於配料能否凸顯醋香，黃耳木耳齋薑醋正是絕佳的示範。肥媽一尾兩用，炮製牛尾湯及陳醋燴牛尾。並示範陳醋炸蛋，及傳授用攪拌機做港式糖水－楊枝甘露。

放射診斷一般涵蓋電腦掃描、磁力共振、X光、超聲波等。放射診斷師指PCCT屬第五代的電腦掃描，比起傳統技術有甚麼優勢？它特別適合心臟病或癌症患者，進行前有何要準備？又有甚麼限制？嘉賓羅家英笑言從母親懷孕期間已醞釀粵劇細胞，並自小跟父親學戲，而最近出書自述生平，少不免提及粵劇在港的發展。家英哥自言沒特長，只能投身粵劇，也執意要將這藝術傳承下去。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓奉上色彩繽紛的「鮮粟米粒椰香帆立貝」。

epg.programme_title_tc: 大灣區美味好玩攻略[粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「灣區遊」壓軸一站來到深圳，先往龍崗區的大型商場，體驗一站式吃喝玩樂。唱K、打棒球、騎馬等，商場內都可玩到！品嚐海鮮餐，烤蝝、蒸黃油蟹，讓主持們大快朵頤。夜訪甘坑古鎮，內裡滿滿的打卡熱點，柏姸、凱文更化身「吹糖人」。向南頭古城前進，除可參觀新安縣衙門古蹟外，深入某間唱片店，竟找到一張麥包當封面的黑膠碟？柏姸、凱文還會換上唐風服飾，大吃麻辣火鍋。眾人再於星級酒店享用下午茶，細味「球王」美斯聯乘漢堡。
閏之感激少游在蘇邁面前替她講好話。大妹接納東坡意思為扇舖換名。季常獲大妹贈扇，月娥醋意大發……東坡與閏之為大妹生爭執，嬌姐向東坡暗示閏之與少游眉來眼去。小妹找閏之被少游打暈；嬌姐決定與少游離開蘇家……

epg.programme_title_tc: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊[粵/日]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南極走失的戴雅三人，為返回飛機接應的地點，繼續在冰天雪地艱難奮進。縱使有歌博士的特製內衣保暖，一旦限時過去，他們則無法抵受嚴寒。三人不斷徘徊，最終來到一個陌生的海岸，就在這時，腳下的冰竟突然裂開…
障礙競技將體操、運動攀登、跑酷(Parkour)三種元素結合，縱然帶有一定的危險性，但同時亦因為有難度，才會讓運動員充滿挑戰心。「Kids’ Notes」請來障礙競技運動員，介紹相關運動所用到的道具，並細說參與世界各地賽事的難忘點滴與得着。比賽亦設小朋友項目，小童運動員也會分享參賽心得。小朋友體重較輕，處理某些障礙或會比成年運動員更有優勢？此外，今集會播放《杯弓蛇影》的AI生成動畫上半部份。
大雄渴望��現寶藏一夜致富，多啦A夢借他「星球探測火箭」，嘗試尋找有寶藏的星球。大雄不願動卻又想去別處，多啦A夢借他「吸盤銅錢」，讓他可以像吸盤魚般黏在別人背後，不費氣力去到目的地。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Joe成為尋寶圖的話事人，若水等人為籌辦感謝祭加班工作，活動過後卻因Joe之故未獲補假，遂向璟風抱怨。璟風向Joe了解此事，終得知是力蓮從中阻撓，令Joe未能成功爭取相關補假，璟風遂提出特別的解決方法。Joe照辦，力蓮卻察覺不妥……Joe與力蓮的鬥爭持續升級，Joe設法討好敢威，力蓮仿效其手法出招，反勝一仗。Joe本欲反擊，卻因璟風的說話有所啟發，有意不再與力蓮相爭，奈何力蓮仍咄咄逼人……

epg.programme_title_tc: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#16[粵][PG]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文森發現曉善身上一件配飾，印有家仁辦公室找到襟章的相同標誌，更發現曉善與家仁是同校學生，開始對曉善展開調查。另一邊廂，潔清也表現得神化，在家仁死後急速辭職。文森查出潔清和曉善的母女關係，但依然未能查證高濃度硫化氫來源，以及曉善到底有否合謀。這時，曉善收到喜訊，表示有機會到外國治療，或可重新站起來！兩母女下定決心離港重過新生，想不到芯凌發現二人關係，對潔清大興問罪之師，甚至對潔清不利！

epg.programme_title_tc: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Eat Play Travel Presents:Journey to Jianghu (Sr.2)[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來到「北嶽」恆山，主持們相約「令狐沖掌門」呂頌賢見面。參觀依山而建的懸空寺，細賞古人的建築智慧。他們於茶舍茹素話當年，小說裡嗜酒如命的令狐沖，現實中卻是滴酒不沾。三人討論《笑傲江湖》內容，提到這是一部充滿悲劇的作品。頌賢坦言對令狐沖又愛又恨，因該角色幾乎霸佔了其演藝人生。雲岡石窟內，雄偉的釋迦牟尼坐像據說是按照北魏皇帝打造。享用大同的歷史美食，百花燒賣獲慈禧讚譽為天下第一籠、鳳趴窩亦深得太后歡心。
在第三次循環，安嵐的行動軌跡改變，丁奇幫助她避過車禍，間接將沃力與墨馬的會面地點改為咖啡店，但咖啡店遭人丟煙霧彈，丁奇抓到犯人，竟是葉坤。墨遠致到大學進行演講，游玉祥以人質要挾，要求重新調查蔣育文案。

報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澤雨痛失至親，到酒吧借酒澆愁。定垚為陪伴澤雨放棄前往布拉格，啟堂責她不夠成熟。松蔭與啟堂以公開天生資金來源逼他低價出讓天生天蔭股份，天生無奈答應。迷債苦主盧啟南綁架定垚，向啟堂勒索千萬。高哲決定辭職，離別前勸諫啟堂要為迷債苦主做點事，否則香港難以翻身。啟堂要兩子準備贖金，同時與各大銀行商議苦主補償方案。定垚明白啟南苦況，願意助他尋求賠償，但啟南堅持取贖金。啟南女兒餵食定垚時，突然抽搐並口吐白沫。
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

放射診斷一般涵蓋電腦掃描、磁力共振、X光、超聲波等。放射診斷師指PCCT屬第五代的電腦掃描，比起傳統技術有甚麼優勢？它特別適合心臟病或癌症患者，進行前有何要準備？又有甚麼限制？嘉賓羅家英笑言從母親懷孕期間已醞釀粵劇細胞，並自小跟父親學戲，而最近出書自述生平，少不免提及粵劇在港的發展。家英哥自言沒特長，只能投身粵劇，也執意要將這藝術傳承下去。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓奉上色彩繽紛的「鮮粟米粒椰香帆立貝」。

epg.programme_title_tc: 大灣區美味好玩攻略[粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「灣區遊」壓軸一站來到深圳，先往龍崗區的大型商場，體驗一站式吃喝玩樂。唱K、打棒球、騎馬等，商場內都可玩到！品嚐海鮮餐，烤蝝、蒸黃油蟹，讓主持們大快朵頤。夜訪甘坑古鎮，內裡滿滿的打卡熱點，柏姸、凱文更化身「吹糖人」。向南頭古城前進，除可參觀新安縣衙門古蹟外，深入某間唱片店，竟找到一張麥包當封面的黑膠碟？柏姸、凱文還會換上唐風服飾，大吃麻辣火鍋。眾人再於星級酒店享用下午茶，細味「球王」美斯聯乘漢堡。
閏之感激少游在蘇邁面前替她講好話。大妹接納東坡意思為扇舖換名。季常獲大妹贈扇，月娥醋意大發……東坡與閏之為大妹生爭執，嬌姐向東坡暗示閏之與少游眉來眼去。小妹找閏之被少游打暈；嬌姐決定與少游離開蘇家……
義為圓當賽車手夢想私下學車，但因看到花手中公仔而失控撞車入院，花取笑義技術差勁，更揭發義受傷原因。喜於是道出義因童年陰影，致每次看到這種公仔時，必定會大失常性，花聽後，內心難安，決定助有義克服陰影。
雪寧想到很多事情都沒有改變，疑惑究竟是否該執意與張遮在一起。尤夫人為芳吟籌謀婚事，想藉此抵債，芳吟極不情願；呂顯想到辦法協助芳吟脫離尤家。謝危先發制人，直接對薛遠談及定非的事，讓薛遠無法下手對付自己…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 慶及花獲選成為商場代言人，唯義仍介懷花破壞他考車牌，竟聯同溢秘密地觀察花，誓要找出花的死穴，但義卻看到富豪阿芹向花示愛。義繼續跟蹤花，發現芹亦邀請花共進晚餐，而義更在約會中看到花粗野的一面。
謝危帶定非回京面聖，一番話令薛遠認下定非，又請聖上將燕家軍印交給他保管；張遮發現母親已死，雪寧為讓他生存下去，故意令他恨自己，謝危安慰傷心的雪寧；雪寧訝異芳吟嫁給了呂顯，芳吟認為這是離開尤家最好方法。
肥媽今集試製素漢堡，揭開素肉以假亂真的秘方。肥媽傳授的黑松露雜菇飯，色、香、味俱全，隨時改變你對素菜單調味寡的印象。此外，一道墨西哥卷，將清新的蔬果變成滋味。今次肥媽不用淮山煲湯，竟配合桂花製成甜品。

epg.programme_title_tc: 才駿HASHTAG 「私人財富」─ 財富+[粵]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孕婦分娩方式各有利弊，婦產科醫生指，順產縱然復原較快，卻有機會導致陰道撕裂等後遺症。剖腹則能減少不確定性，但屬開腹手術，存在黏連等長遠風險。醫生詳析相關資訊，為準媽媽提供貼心建議。「跟大廚去搵食」再由李文星師傅帶路，這次引領大王與菲比前往新派粵菜食府，「法國龍眼蜜煎金蠔」、「牛油果金槍魚鹹蛋酥」、「雞骨草咖啡煙熏BB鴿」等佳餚，展現中西融合的烹調創意。「睇餸食飯」，三姐示範「鮮蜆水瓜半煎煮魚雲」。

三位主持到澳門旅遊塔測試膽色挑戰自己，林正峰能否成功爬上塔頂？何沛珈與陳楨怡玩雙人高飛跳，又能否克服高空離心力的恐懼？刺激過後到VR科技城享受打機樂趣，再到澳門大賽車博物館參觀，感受賽車氣氛之後熱血沸騰，駕駛小型賽車用速度鬥快鬥刺激！誰勝誰負？三人欣賞塗鴉壁畫又學整Graffiti T-Shirt，再參觀澳門不同廟宇，學習搓香感受傳統文化，坐開蓬巴士夜遊澳門，最後走入哈利波特展覽的魔法世界，進入電影場景的奇幻旅程。

epg.programme_title_tc: 才駿HASHTAG 「私人財富」─ 財富+[粵]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王旁因蘇邁取出的「巨大毛筆」爆炸而患上失心瘋，道士稱蘇邁飲了符水王旁才有救。王夫人逼蘇邁飲符水，閏之撲前飲下嘔吐大作……東坡派少游視察養蠶業，小妹以監察為名跟隨。蠶寶寶離奇死亡，二人到後山草叢調查……

epg.programme_title_tc: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊[粵/日]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 智悟、皮皮，還有無人機天才美娜與程式天才俊浩，在奧丁社長的邀請下，來到由人工智慧管理的AI城市。在高性能AI瑪姬娜帶領下，智悟一行遊覽這城市各個角落，在感嘆新科技的神奇之餘，卻又發現某些地方很不對勁……
芭菲精靈笑臉迎接前來挑戰的男、女兵團，首先要兩隊接受「廠長話」考驗。男子組有成員因重心不穩，不慎於沒有「廠長話」指令下放低了腿。幸好芭菲精靈給予一次機會，才得以繼續遊戲。在神奇地壺關卡中，女子隊成功「加碼」，完成三個「收集」任務，男生們能否超越這成績？走過「溶化之橋」時，首位女生挑戰運送五個雪糕球未能成功，但她並未退縮，第二次仍勇敢選擇運送相同數量，並力求穩步到達終點……
毒菇城主木野小次郎竹高，想查明稗田八方齋秘密休養的原因。校長先生拜託亂太郎把一封燒焦了的信，帶去給金樂寺的大師。學期完結休假，大家都回家探親。小丸突然不捨得與亂太郎及新丁分開。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 力蓮原本與Joe相鬥，卻因某些緣故將矛頭轉向尚善，視她為最大威脅，但並未與尚善正面衝突，而是以其他方法試圖令她自動消失。尚善察覺異樣，並從力王口中得知一事，明白力蓮暗中搞小動作的真正原因；樹仁碰巧聽到二人對話，遂將事情告知熊家眾人，眾人大感高興！另一方面，潮偉找到金主投資拍攝新片，打算邀請尚善出任編劇，此時卻得知尚善留在接龍或會更上一層樓，遂希望她慎重考慮再下決定。尚善本已立定主意，詎料……

epg.programme_title_tc: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#17[粵][PG]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文森已找到曉善和家仁的衝突片段，正式拉曉善和潔清回去問話。然而，表面證據無法控告曉善合謀殺人，文森放虎歸山，令事情變得更明朗，潔清亦將一切和盤托出。文森細思案情，發現潔清、芯凌和逸思口供存着微微的矛盾，卻礙於表面證供成立，只能對潔清作出起訴。這時，為文森帶來頭緒的頻道再上載新影片，讓文森發現頻道是在復刻家仁生前的得意整蠱作品，表面是向家仁致敬，背後卻想將「閉氣挑戰」重演……

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 山西汾酒被譽為四大名酒之一，師兄弟憑酒寄意，試為對方調配汾酒雞尾酒。黎耀祥提醒師弟「淡定D」，麥包則祝福師兄「有財又開心」？釀醋文化亦是山西的「武功絕學」，兩主持一探繁複講究的釀醋步驟，淺嚐不同年份的老陳醋，更以演戲需要時間醞釀來形容？平遙古城保存着明清時期的建築，時至今日仍有居民生活。師兄弟遊走這個「千年活古城」，解開古代票號兌換匯票的密碼，還會從晉商菜細味箇中歷史古韻，每一道佳餚都大有來頭！
玉祥脅持人質遭方鷺槍殺，後來發現他持的是假刀，根本無意傷害人，讓方鷺後悔不已。外賣員傅駿在第三次循環中還是死去，讓丁奇感詫異。遠致憶述往事，認為當年育文妒忌自己。第四次循環中，丁奇奇怪地覺得自己死過…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。
報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 定垚救人受傷，擔心腳傷影響跳舞。天生拿着孝聰死前不雅短片，成功要脅松蔭將天蔭中心轉讓予明晞。澤雨氣憤不已，為了重振家族事業，毅然向定垚提出分手，定垚難以接受。天生、明晞手挽手走進天蔭中心，想起二人在此相識的經過，天生還向明晞求婚。高哲到溫哥華尋找思妤不果，黯然神傷，二人各自重遊舊地卻失之交臂。明晞不滿意富豪們都不出席婚宴，天生略耍手段令啟堂不得不出現，眾富豪亦聞風前往，而松蔭也突然現身婚宴……
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

孕婦分娩方式各有利弊，婦產科醫生指，順產縱然復原較快，卻有機會導致陰道撕裂等後遺症。剖腹則能減少不確定性，但屬開腹手術，存在黏連等長遠風險。醫生詳析相關資訊，為準媽媽提供貼心建議。「跟大廚去搵食」再由李文星師傅帶路，這次引領大王與菲比前往新派粵菜食府，「法國龍眼蜜煎金蠔」、「牛油果金槍魚鹹蛋酥」、「雞骨草咖啡煙熏BB鴿」等佳餚，展現中西融合的烹調創意。「睇餸食飯」，三姐示範「鮮蜆水瓜半煎煮魚雲」。

三位主持到澳門旅遊塔測試膽色挑戰自己，林正峰能否成功爬上塔頂？何沛珈與陳楨怡玩雙人高飛跳，又能否克服高空離心力的恐懼？刺激過後到VR科技城享受打機樂趣，再到澳門大賽車博物館參觀，感受賽車氣氛之後熱血沸騰，駕駛小型賽車用速度鬥快鬥刺激！誰勝誰負？三人欣賞塗鴉壁畫又學整Graffiti T-Shirt，再參觀澳門不同廟宇，學習搓香感受傳統文化，坐開蓬巴士夜遊澳門，最後走入哈利波特展覽的魔法世界，進入電影場景的奇幻旅程。
王旁因蘇邁取出的「巨大毛筆」爆炸而患上失心瘋，道士稱蘇邁飲了符水王旁才有救。王夫人逼蘇邁飲符水，閏之撲前飲下嘔吐大作……東坡派少游視察養蠶業，小妹以監察為名跟隨。蠶寶寶離奇死亡，二人到後山草叢調查……
慶及花獲選成為商場代言人，唯義仍介懷花破壞他考車牌，竟聯同溢秘密地觀察花，誓要找出花的死穴，但義卻看到富豪阿芹向花示愛。義繼續跟蹤花，發現芹亦邀請花共進晚餐，而義更在約會中看到花粗野的一面。
謝危帶定非回京面聖，一番話令薛遠認下定非，又請聖上將燕家軍印交給他保管；張遮發現母親已死，雪寧為讓他生存下去，故意令他恨自己，謝危安慰傷心的雪寧；雪寧訝異芳吟嫁給了呂顯，芳吟認為這是離開尤家最好方法。
台灣見學旅程包括採蚵及親手拉麵線，可惜Cyrus及Cindy未能達標！主持安排他們與兩位台灣小廚神進行交流，煮出一碗美味麵線，Cindy的「嫩雞麵線」足料美味，竟然吸引不到主持的目光！留港小廚神手執龍蝦，做出三道賣相類近的「熱沙律」，味道上哪一碟取勝？陳庭欣、宋熙年與三位男性小廚神同場煮早餐，陳庭欣的刀工及廚藝略嫌不足、Cameron的法式多士看似燒焦，竟能為主持送上無窮驚喜！

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亨對美食全無興趣，被證實患上厭食症。高家出盡法寶仍未令他恢愎食慾。麗說悅發現亨的情信，內容指他很掛念一個人，對方卻多番失約，連生日亦遺下他一人獨過。悅竟指信中人是麗，但實情是亨心中有另一個重要的人。
沈玠私見姜雪蕙，被薛姝看到，未幾京中便流傳起姜雪寧在通州的風流韻事。姜伯游為了女兒，毅然在朝堂上參薛遠貪墨賑災糧款，張遮也將薛姝濫用興武衛職權散佈姜雪寧流言之事呈稟，沈琅大怒，命謝危與張遮徹查興武衛。

epg.programme_title_en: Manulife Presents:Live Longer. Live in Control.[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《宏利保險呈獻：掌握健康人生》邀請醫學界及保險界專家，深入淺出探討癌症預防、治療及相關檢查的知識，助您把握黃金時間，從容掌握健康保障貼士。
《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。
三位愛玩的主持一大早跑步上東望洋炮台俯瞰澳門半島！不懂土風舞的主持變裝學跳舞，能否跳得似模似樣？跳到肚餓跟土生葡人廚師學煮土生菜，體驗地道文化又品嚐美味！到龍環葡韻參觀，感受昔日土生葡人生活方式，跟葡國磚藝術畫家學製手繪瓷磚過後，當然要享受大廚精心炮製的傳統葡國大餐，再到頂層酒吧學調Mocktail談心，互相分享真摯感受來結束這次豐富精彩的旅程。
月娥逼大妹讓她入股一扇軒，更以催財為名在店內佈置風水陣，季常卻認出這是催病陣。王雱向東坡表示要憑本領應考科舉，東坡欣賞答應讓大妹嫁他，王蘇兩家會晤傾談婚事細節……為籌措大妹的嫁妝費，東坡減少應酬……

epg.programme_title_tc: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊[粵/日]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 智悟一行潛入AI城市的住宅區，途中卻被系統發現，受到全城居民追捕。就在這時，據報失蹤的天才少年維辰竟現身相救。按維辰說法，出席奧丁社長演講的科研人員都被關進這座城市，作為他控制全人類計劃的第一步……

小朋友或會對學習數學感疑惑，家長未必懂得解答。數學補習導師作客「Kids’ Notes」，提到數學對生活的重要，更指出令人感到沉悶的不是數學，而是數學練習！學數學可怎樣入手？試試隨父母入超市購物，已可連結到百分比、加減、折扣等知識；藉課外書了解數學家的歷史，也能從不同方向增加對學習的好奇心和趣味性。小學生常因大意而犯錯，尤其是抄錯數字或單位，建議做完題目後要複查。家長協助子女溫書，又有何注意事項？
BB超人來探訪叔果Jam叔他們。剛巧果Jam叔他們正準備前往雞蛋王國，BB超人於是一同上路。大碗飯三人組爭論哪一種飯最好吃。鑊仔飯人為了證明鑊仔飯是最好吃的，決定前往天狗之森採集野菇作為材料。
緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文森認定該影片頻道跟家仁的死有關，全力調查背後操控者。文森發現該人更曾因為家仁導致流產，警方即鎖定該人全力通緝。頻道預告會重演「閉氣挑戰」，並針對某人復仇，文森趕往救人，卻發現中了圈套。然而頻道又再策劃一場驚天地、泣鬼神的大型直播整蠱，文森擔心會出意外到場勸止，但直播已經開始……
